Only\nheadings, emphasis, lists, links and images (with alt text) are kept.\n\nTwo things keep the page accessible whatever an Editor types: headings in a Body\nare moved below the page's own <h1> without skipping a level, and an image with\nno alt text gets a plain fallback instead of none.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\nimport nh3\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True})\n\n_TAGS = {\n    \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"p\", \"br\", \"em\", \"strong\",\n    \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\", \"a\", \"img\",\n}\n_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\", \"title\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\", \"title\"}}\n_URL_SCHEMES = {\"http\", \"https\", \"mailto\"}\n\n# Approved image files are copied to <site>/images/. An Editor always writes\n# `images/<file>`; each page adds the `root` that gets from there to the site root.\nNO_ALT = \"Image without a description\"\n\n_HEADING = re.compile(r\"<(/?)h([1-6])>\")\n_IMG_WITHOUT_ALT = re.compile(r\"<img(?![^>]*\\salt=)\")\n# `images/x.png`, `./images/x.png` and `../images/x.png` all mean the approved-images folder.\n_IMAGES_REFERENCE = re.compile(r\"^(?:\\.{1,2}/)*(images/.*)$\", re.S)\n\n\ndef _attribute_filter(root: str):\n    def keep(tag: str, name: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n        \"\"\"Drop root-absolute links and images (the site is served from a\n        subfolder), point `images/...` at the site root, and never leave alt empty.\"\"\"\n        if name in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip().startswith(\"/\"):\n            return None\n        if tag == \"img\" and name == \"src\":\n            reference = _IMAGES_REFERENCE.match(value)\n            if reference:\n                return root + reference.group(1)\n        if tag == \"img\" and name == \"alt\" and not value.strip():\n            return NO_ALT\n        return value\n\n    return keep\n\n\ndef _nest_headings(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Body headings start at <h2> and never skip a level.\n\n    The page's own title is the only <h1>. A heading may be at most one level\n    deeper than the one before it; siblings stay siblings.\n    \"\"\"\n    last_level = 1      # the page's own <h1>\n    open_level = 2      # level of the heading currently open\n\n    def fix(match: re.Match) -> str:\n        nonlocal last_level, open_level\n        if match.group(1):\n            return f\"</h{open_level}>\"\n        open_level = min(max(int(match.group(2)), 2), last_level + 1)\n        last_level = open_level\n        return f\"<h{open_level}>\"\n\n    return _HEADING.sub(fix, html)\n\n\ndef render_body(markdown: str, root: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"`root` is the relative path from the page to the site root (\"\" or \"../\").\"\"\"\n    html = nh3.clean(\n        _markdown.render(markdown),\n        tags=_TAGS,\n        attributes=_ATTRIBUTES,\n        url_schemes=_URL_SCHEMES,\n        clean_content_tags={\"script\", \"style\", \"iframe\", \"form\"},\n        attribute_filter=_attribute_filter(root),\n    )\n    html = _IMG_WITHOUT_ALT.sub(f'<img alt=\"{NO_ALT}\"', html)\n    return _nest_headings(html)\n\"\"\"Post screens: list, write, edit, publish, delete, and the Admin-only slug.\n\nEach route names its action in `Depends(require(...))`; the rule table in\napp/permissions.py decides who may. Permission is checked before the Post is\nlooked up.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import posts\nfrom app.permissions import require\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _db(request: Request):\n    return request.app.state.database\n\n\ndef _edit_url(request: Request, post_id: int) -> str:\n    return request.app.url_path_for(\"edit_post\", post_id=post_id)\n\n\ndef _found(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = posts.get(_db(request), post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, *, post=None, status_code=200, **context):\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", status_code=status_code,\n                  title=\"Edit Post\" if post else \"New Post\", \"admin/post_list.html\", title=\"Posts\",\n                  user=request.state.user, posts=posts.list_all(_db(request)))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.create\"))])\ndef new_post(request: Request):\n    return _form(request, title_value=\"\", body_value=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", title=title, body=body,\n                               author_id=request.state.user[\"id\"])\n    except posts.PostError as error:\n        return _form(request, status_code=400, error=str(error),\n                     title_value=title, body_value=body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.edit\"))])\ndef edit_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = _found(request, post_id)\n    return _form(request, post=post, title_value=post[\"title\"], body_value=post[\"body\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.edit\"))])\ndef save_post(request: Request, post_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = post=post, status_code=400, error=str(error),\n                     title_value=title, body_value=body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/publish\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.publish\"))])\ndef publish_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    _found(request, post_id)\n    posts.publish(_db(request), post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/unpublish\", posts.change_slug(_db(request), post_id, slug)\n    except posts.PostError as error:\n        code = 409 if isinstance(error, posts.SlugTaken) else 400\n        return _form(request, post=post, status_code=code, slug_error=str(error),\n                     title_value=post[\"title\"], body_value=post[\"body\"])\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), named route, e.g. route('edit_post', post_id=3).\n\n    Templates use this instead of writing \"/admin/...\" by hand, so a link or\n    form action follows its route if the route's path ever changes.\n    \"\"\"\n    return context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **params)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"route\"] = route\n\n\ndef stamp(iso: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A stored UTC time as \"2026-10-12 04:24 UTC\" (the minute is enough to tell edits apart).\"\"\"\n    return iso[:16].replace(\"T\", \" \") + \" UTC\"\n\n\ntemplates.env.filters[\"stamp\"] = stamp\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    \"\"\"Render an admin template with the CSRF token every form needs.\"\"\"\n    context.setdefault(\"title\", \"Admin\")\n    context[\"csrf_token\"] = security.csrf_token(request)\n    context[\"home_path\"] = request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, name, context, status_code=status_code)\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (signed-in only), with /login and /logout\nbeside it; the public site preview answers at /.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app.permissions import PermissionRefused\nfrom app.publish import WELCOME\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, pages, posts, users\nfrom app.web import render, templates\n\nSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\n\n\ndef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\n    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(PermissionRefused)\n    def refuse(request: Request, _: PermissionRefused):\n        return render(request, \"admin/refused.html\", status_code=403,\n                      title=\"No permission\", user=request.state.user)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"root\": \"\", \"welcome\": WELCOME, \"posts\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\n    # guard runs, and saved after it.\n    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\"cms_session\",\n        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"465b22ed-388c-4133-a606-d28839ca80c9","timestamp":"2026-10-13T00:58:59.265Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Markdown Body -> safe HTML. Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\n    # guard runs, and saved after it.\n    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\"cms_session\",\n        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"adc469b8-0541-4f43-8884-00365d4b0832","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"b68357c6-d59e-4995-a597-7ee18ee605d2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a77ef331-d963-4153-904a-5fde226c3f3f","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ route('post_list') }}\">All Posts</a></p>\n  <h1>{% if post %}Edit Post{% else %}New Post{% endif %}</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{% if post %}{{ route('save_post', post_id=post.id) }}{% else %}{{ route('create_post') }}{% endif %}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <p><label>Title <input name=\"title\" value=\"{{ title_value }}\" required></label></p>\n    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br>\n      <textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"14\" cols=\"60\">{{ body_value }}</textarea></label></p>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">{% if post %}Save changes{% else %}Save as Draft{% endif %}</button></p>\n  </form>\n\n  {% if post %}\n  <dl>\n    <dt>Status</dt><dd><strong id=\"post-status\">{{ post.status | capitalize }}</strong></dd>\n    <dt>Author</dt><dd>{{ post.author_name }}</dd>\n    <dt>Slug</dt><dd><code id=\"post-slug\">{{ post.slug }}</code></dd>\n    <dt>Created</dt><dd><time id=\"created\" datetime=\"{{ post.created_at }}\">{{ post.created_at[:16] | replace('T', ' ') }} UTC</time></dd>\n    <dt>Updated</dt><dd><time id=\"updated\" datetime=\"{{ post.updated_at }}\">{{ post.updated_at[:16] | replace('T', ' ') }} UTC</time></dd>\n    <dt>First published</dt>\n    <dd>{% if post.first_published_at %}<time id=\"first-published\" datetime=\"{{ post.first_published_at }}\">{{ post.first_published_at[:16] | replace('T', ' ') }} UTC</time>{% else %}Not yet published{% endif %}</dd>\n  </dl>\n\n  {% if post.status == 'draft' %}\n  {% if can(user.role, 'post.publish') %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ route('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Mark Published</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% elif can(user.role, 'post.unpublish') %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ route('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <button Templates ask\n`can(role, action)` only to hide controls; hiding is never the protection.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\nEVERYONE = frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR})\nADMIN_ONLY = frozenset({ADMIN})\n\nRULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"content.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"dashboard.account_counts\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"post.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.create\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.edit\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.publish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.unpublish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"post.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"page.edit_body\": EVERYONE,\n    \"page.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.retitle\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.publish\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.unpublish\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.list\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.view\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.change_role\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.deactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.reactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.reset_password\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.change_display_name\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n}\n\n\nclass PermissionRefused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The signed-in account's role may not do this action.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef allowed(role: str, action: str) -> bool:\n    # An action missing from the table is refused, never allowed by accident.\n    return role in RULES.get(action, frozenset())\n\n\ndef require(action: str):\n    \"\"\"A route dependency: refuse the request unless the role may `action`.\n\n    Runs before the route looks anything up, so an Editor gets the same\n    refusal whether or not the thing they asked about exists.\n    \"\"\"\n    if action not in RULES:\n        raise KeyError(f\"unknown action: {action}\")\n\n    def check(request: Request) -> None:\n        if not allowed(request.state.user[\"role\"], action):\n            raise PermissionRefused(action)\n\n    return check\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nTwo rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     Pages one folder down (posts/) reach the site root with a `root` of \"../\".\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import pages, settings\nfrom app.db import connect\nfrom app.rendering import render_body\n\n# The wording comes from notes/client-brief.md. Make no other claim about ASA.\nWELCOME = (\n    \"ASA is a Kenyon student group primarily for African students and students \"\n    \"with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African \"\n    \"cultures and community.\"\n)\nHOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS = 5\nEXCERPT_CHARS = 140\n# Approved image files the release-holder may add to images/. Anything else is ignored.\nIMAGE_SUFFIXES = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".gif\", \".webp\", \".svg\"}\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _day(timestamp: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A stored UTC timestamp as (\"2026-09-28\", \"28 September 2026\").\"\"\"\n    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp)\n    return moment.date().isoformat(), f\"{moment.day} {moment:%B %Y}\"\n\n\ndef _published_posts(database: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Published Posts only, newest First-published date first.\n\n    Ordered by First-published date, not by edit time, so a correction never\n    moves a Post. The byline is the Author's Display name; the Username is not\n    even selected.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(database)) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT posts.title, posts.slug, posts.body, posts.updated_at, \"\n            \"posts.first_published_at, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n            \"FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id \"\n            \"WHERE posts.status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY posts.first_published_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    return [_post_for_template(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef card_excerpt(body_html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a Post's rendered Body as plain text, for its Event card.\n\n    Works on sanitized output, which holds only a handful of tags. Inline tags vanish\n    (\"**demo**,\" stays \"demo,\"), block ends become spaces, and list items are told\n    apart by \" · \" so \"What: a party When: soon\" does not run together.\n    \"\"\"\n    text = body_html.replace(\"</li>\", \" · \")\n    text = re.sub(r\"</(?:p|ul|ol|h[1-6])>|<br\\s*/?>\", \" \", text)\n    text = \" \".join(html.unescape(re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \"\", text)).split()).strip(\" ·\")\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_CHARS:\n        return text\n    # Cut at a word end: looking one character past the limit keeps a word that ends exactly on it.\n    cut = text[:EXCERPT_CHARS + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_CHARS]\n    return cut.rstrip(\" ,.;:·\") + \"…\"\n\n\ndef _post_for_template(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:\n    posted_iso, posted_label = _day(row[\"first_published_at\"])\n    body_html = render_body(row[\"body\"], root=\"../\")\n    post = {\n        \"title\": row[\"title\"], \"slug\": row[\"slug\"], \"author_name\": row[\"author_name\"],\n        \"body_html\": body_html, \"excerpt\": card_excerpt(body_html),\n        \"posted_iso\": posted_iso, \"posted_label\": posted_label,\n        \"updated_iso\": None, \"updated_label\": None,\n    }\n    if row[\"updated_at\"] > row[\"first_published_at\"]:\n        post[\"updated_iso\"], post[\"updated_label\"] = _day(row[\"updated_at\"])\n    return post\n\n\ndef copy_images(source: Path, out: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Copy the release-holder's approved image files to <site>/images/.\n\n    Only image files are copied (by extension), and never hidden ones, so a stray\n    `.env` or script dropped in the folder cannot reach the public site.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not source.is_dir():\n        return\n    for path in sorted(source.rglob(\"*\")):\n        relative = path.relative_to(source)\n        if (path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in IMAGE_SUFFIXES\n                and not any(part.startswith(\".\") for part in relative.parts)):\n            target = out / \"images\" / relative\n            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n            shutil.copyfile(path, target)\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None,\n                images: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    images = images or settings.IMAGES\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    published = _published_posts(database)\n    published_pages = pages.list_published(database)\n    # Every page of the site shows the same Navigation; the template prefixes `root`.\n    nav_pages = [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"slug\": page[\"slug\"]} for page in published_pages]\n    common = {\"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"short_title\": settings.SITE_SHORT_TITLE,\n              \"instagram_url\": settings.INSTAGRAM_URL, \"nav_pages\": nav_pages}\n\n    def write(name: str, template: str, **context) -> None:\n        (out / name).write_text(env.get_template(template).render(\n            **common, **context))\n\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text((settings.TEMPLATES / \"public\" / \"style.css\").read_text())\n    copy_images(images, out)\n    write(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\", title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=\"\",\n          welcome=WELCOME, posts=published[:HOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS], card_level=3)\n    write(\"announcements.html\", \"public/announcements.html\",\n          title=f\"Announcements · {settings.SITE_TITLE}\", root=\"\", posts=published,\n          current=\"announcements\")\n    for post in published:\n        write(f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\", \"public/post.html\", root=\"../\", post=post,\n              title=post[\"title\"], current=\"announcements\")\n    for page in published_pages:\n        write(f\"{page['slug']}.html\", \"public/page.html\", root=\"\", title=page[\"title\"],\n              current=page[\"slug\"],\n              page={\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"body_html\": render_body(page[\"body\"])})\n    return out\n\"\"\"Accounts: creating them, hashing passwords, checking sign-in.\n\nA password is never stored, returned or logged in plain form; only the argon2\nhash is kept. The username is private (sign-in only); the Display name is the\npublic byline. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\nROLES = (\"admin\", \"editor\")\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked when the username is unknown, so a miss takes as long as a wrong\n# password and timing does not reveal which usernames exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"not-a-real-password\")\n\n\nclass AccountError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A request about an account that cannot be honoured (shown to the Admin).\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UsernameTaken(AccountError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef hash_password(password: str) -> str:\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _password_matches(stored_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(stored_hash, password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return False\n\n\ndef _check_password_length(password: str) -> None:\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise AccountError(\n            f\"The password must be at least {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters.\")\n\n\ndef create_account(path: Path, *, username: str, password: str, role: str,\n                   display_name: str) -> int:\n    username, display_name = username.strip(), display_name.strip()\n    if not username or not display_name:\n        raise AccountError(\"A username and a Display name are required.\")\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Role must be one of: {', '.join(ROLES)}.\")\n    _check_password_length(password)\n    try:\n        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role, display_name) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (username, hash_password(password), role, display_name),\n            )\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise UsernameTaken(f\"An account named '{username}' already exists.\") from None\n\n\ndef authenticate(path: Path, username: str, password: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the account for a correct username and password, else None.\n\n    An unknown username, a wrong password and a Deactivated account all return\n    None, so the caller can give one generic message for all three.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        user = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?\", (username.strip(),)\n        ).fetchone()\n    matches = _password_matches(user[\"password_hash\"] if user else _DUMMY_HASH,\n                                password)\n    if user is None or not matches or not user[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_user(path: Path, user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return The account is looked up on every request, so a\nDeactivated account stops working immediately.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.types import ASGIApp, Receive, Scope, Send\n\nfrom app import accounts\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The signed-in, active account for this request, or None.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = accounts.get_user(request.app.state.database, user_id)\n    if user is None or not user[\"active\"]:\n        request.session.clear()\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef sign_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on sign-in, so nothing from before it lives on.\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n\n\ndef sign_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject any state-changing request that lacks this session's token.\n\n    Registered on the whole app, so a new route cannot forget it.\n    \"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    form = await request.form()\n    supplied = form.get(\"csrf_token\") or \"\"\n    if not expected or not secrets.compare_digest(str(supplied), expected):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n\n\nclass AdminGuard:\n    \"\"\"Send anyone who is not signed in away from every /admin address.\n\n    A middleware rather than a per-route check, so it also covers addresses\n    that do not exist (they must not answer differently to a signed-out scope[\"type\"] == \"http\" and (\n                scope[\"path\"] == \"/admin\" or scope[\"path\"].startswith(\"/admin/\")):\n            request = Request(scope, receive)\n            user = current_user(request)\n            if user is None:\n                await RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)(scope, receive, send)\n                return\n            scope.setdefault(\"state\", {})[\"user\"] = user\n        await self.app(scope, receive, send)\n\"\"\"Posts: the data rules (slugs, Author, First-published date).\n\nNothing here knows about HTTP. \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The signed-in, active account for this request, or None.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = accounts.get_user(request.app.state.database, user_id)\n    if user is None or not user[\"active\"]:\n        request.session.clear()\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef sign_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on sign-in, so nothing from before it lives on.\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n\n\ndef sign_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> scope[\"type\"] == \"http\" and (\n                scope[\"path\"] == \"/admin\" or scope[\"path\"].startswith(\"/admin/\")):\n            request = Request(scope, receive)\n            user = current_user(request)\n            if user is None:\n                await RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)(scope, receive, send)\n                return\n            scope.setdefault(\"state\", {})[\"user\"] = user\n        await self.app(scope, receive, send)\n\"\"\"Posts: the data rules (slugs, Author, First-published date).\n\nNothing here knows about HTTP. pass\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", Read #3, spec #1 and `CONTEXT.md` first (see `CLAUDE.md`).\n- 50 tests pass with `uv run pytest -q`.\n- The usage ledger and the session 06 transcript (the `/to-tickets` planning session, not T01) were committed after T01 in a `docs:` commit. The T01 session's own transcript is written by the SessionEnd hook, so it may appear untracked; it may also be saved under a `your-name` filename that needs renaming to `yaw-oppong-krampah`, as in commit 0ed92c9.\n- `uv run python scripts/usage_report.py --remaining 7` says the remaining tickets FIT the cap. T01 cost about 3% of the 5h window.\n\n## Things not obvious from the code\n- Sign-in identifier is the **username**, not an email. `tests/conftest.py` `client_as(role)` signs in with a CSRF token against a per-test seeded temp DB. `csrf_token(client, path)` and `token_in(html)` are the helpers for tests that POST.\n- `test_t00.py::test_admin_console_answers` was edited on purpose to sign in first, because signed-out `/admin` now redirects to `/login`.\n- `create_app(database=Path)` takes a DB path (default `settings.DATABASE_PATH`). Schema is created on first `db.connect()`.\n- Guards: `security.AdminGuard` middleware protects every `/admin*` path. CSRF is an app-wide dependency (`security.verify_csrf`), so new POST routes get it automatically. Admin templates should render through `web.render` to get the token; forms need `<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">`.\n- `web.render` sets `home_path=\"/admin\"` on the shared `base.html`. Never reuse that context in the publish step.\n- `.env` is not auto-loaded. Use `uv run --env-file .env ...`.\n- Admin pages have no stylesheet yet (`base.html` links a relative `style.css`, which 404s under the admin).\n- Session-per-phase rule: write the ticket id (e.g. `T02`) to `.claude/state/phase` at the start of the session. That file is gitignored. Commits must start `T0N:` and end with `Closes #N`, and code-review findings must be posted on the issue before the closing commit.\n- No non-Anthropic backend was in use (base URL unset), so no `Backend:` commit trailer is needed unless `/status` shows one.\n- Commit attribution trailer from the session: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.\n\n## Suggested skills\n- `mattpocock-skills:implement` with the ticket number (e.g. `#3`) to run the ticket end to end.\n- `mattpocock-skills:tdd` for the test-first loop at the HTTP seam.\n- `mattpocock-skills:code-review` before the closing commit. Mark new files with `git add -N` first so they appear in the diff.\n- `mattpocock-skills:domain-modeling` only if a term is missing from `CONTEXT.md`.\n# Token budget plan\n\nPart 5.4 of the manual. Written **before** the first `/implement` session.\n\n> **Every percentage in this file is a pre-work ESTIMATE, not measured usage.**\n> Nothing here comes from `notes/usage-ledger.csv`. Actual numbers will come\n> from `uv run python scripts/usage_report.py` after T01 and T03 (Part 5.6),\n> and the final report compares this plan against them.\n\n## 1. Which models I can use\n\n- **Confirmed in use:** Sonnet 5 and Sonnet 5.5 (the only models in the ledger so far).\n  `~/.claude/settings.json` defaults to `sonnet`, effort `medium`.\n- **Not yet confirmed for my Pro account:** Opus and `opusplan`, and Haiku.\n  Before T01, run /model and update this table if other models are available.\n  If Opus is not offered or is very costly on Pro,\n  use the **Sonnet-only** column; the plan still works, just with less headroom\n  on planning quality.\n- I will not assume model names or availability beyond what `/model` shows.\n\n## 2. Plan by stage (estimates, as % of ONE 5-hour window)\n\n| Stage | Model (if listed by `/model`) | Sonnet-only fallback | Effort | Est. % of a 5h window |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| Setup Exercise A: context-threshold hook | Sonnet | same | medium | 5 |\n| Setup Exercise B: `spend()` via `/tdd` | Sonnet | same | medium | 5 |\n| `/grill` (one session, fresh window) | Opus / `opusplan` | Sonnet | high | 15 |\n| `/to-spec` | Opus / `opusplan` | Sonnet | high | 10 |\n| `/to-tickets` | Opus / `opusplan` | Sonnet | high | 10 |\n| `/implement` + `/tdd`, **per ticket** (x8) | Sonnet | same | medium | 20 each, 160 total |\n| `/code-review`, **per ticket** (x8) | Sonnet | same | high | 8 each, 64 total |\n| Publish to Pages + submission chores | Sonnet or Haiku | Sonnet | low | 5 |\n| **Subtotal** | | | | **~274** |\n| Rework / drift / long-ticket buffer (+25%) | | | | ~68 |\n| **Total** | | | | **~340** |\n\nNotes on the numbers:\n- Implementation is the biggest line because each ticket is a tracer bullet\n  (model + route + template + tests) plus a test-first loop with reruns.\n- Planning stages are guessed at high effort because a bad spec is the most\n- **Body:** repo URL, Pages URL, tag name.\n\nYou get a short report back within 48 hours: the checker results, whether your ticket set is sound, and the one fix to make before Stage 2.\n\n### 8.2 Stage 2 (Tue Oct 6, grace to Oct 7)\n\n**Screenshots** (6 screens × 1280 px and 390 px) into `docs/screenshots/`: login, dashboard, content list, editor, users, and the page an editor sees when refused an admin screen.\n\n**README** must have: *Live URL*, *Run locally* (steps that actually work on a clean clone), and a *Generative AI Use Statement* containing your models and skills, **two prompts you really used, quoted**, **one real model failure**, and a *Backends used* table (see Part 9).\n\n**Report** — `docs/iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md`, 1–2 pages, answering four questions:\n\n1. What did you build, and which decisions in the grill were **yours**?\n2. Where did the AI drift or invent something, and what caught it?\n3. Which skills, prompts, and resources did you use, and why those?\n4. What would you add next, and what did the budget data tell you?\n\nWrite it yourself. Edited AI drafting is fine; unedited AI output is the single biggest cost in the rubric. Include the specific: a bug you hit, a decision you regret, a number from your ledger.\n\n```bash\nuv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2\ngit tag mp2-final && git push --tags\n```\n\nEmail with subject `IPHS400 MP2 Stage 2 — First Last`, the three links, and the report attached.\n\n---\n\n## Part 9 — Plan B: swapping the backend (emergencies only)\n\nUse this **only** if your forecast in 5.6 says you will run out of Pro usage before Stage 2. Anthropic stays required for the grill, spec, tickets, and `/code-review`, so everyone's process evidence stays comparable.\n\n### 9.1 Set it up without breaking your normal setup\n\nKeep the config **outside the repo** and launch it with an alias, so plain `claude` still uses Pro and no key ever reaches a commit.\n\n\nFor **Z.ai (GLM)** the same file instead holds `\"ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL\": \"https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic\"`, your Z.ai key in `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `\"API_TIMEOUT_MS\": \"3000000\"`, and the model-mapping variables (`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`, and so on) from Z.ai's Claude Code documentation. Z.ai's coding plans are paid; check current prices before buying anything.\n\n**Verify:**\n\n```text\n/status\n```\n\n**Expected:** `Anthropic base URL: https://openrouter.ai/api`.\n**If it still shows Anthropic:** a cached login is overriding your variables. Run `/logout` once, relaunch, and check again.\n\n**Optional 10-minute smoke test (recommended, free):** with OpenRouter, pick one of its free models and ask the session to run one trivial task. Now you know the fallback works before you need it.\n\n### 9.2 Rules\n\n- **Switch only at ticket boundaries**, right after `/clear`. Never mid-ticket.\n- **Expect differences.** OpenRouter states Claude Code is only guaranteed with Anthropic's own models; tool calling — which `/tdd` and the skills depend on — can be less reliable elsewhere.\n- **Your code goes to a third party.** Read that provider's data policy first.\n- **Declare it, three ways:** a row in the README *Backends used* table; a `Backend: <provider> <model>` trailer on every commit made in that session; and the ledger's `provider` column, which records it automatically. {"parentUuid":"24b5e2e8-86ab-42a9-a234-b81f837f3afb","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyLG6VNh1cz3tMozMfNE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Fwu3Axa1rY45PEBcqGAoaH","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t08_preview.py","content":"\"\"\"T08: Preview and the Event details hint.\n\nSeam 1 (the admin console over HTTP) for the editor screens, with one look at\nSeam 2 (the published site on disk) to prove the Preview shows what goes Live.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import pages, posts\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_token\nfrom tests.test_t03_publish import add_post, author_id, publish, read\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import add_page, is_refusal\n\n# Everything an Editor's Body could try, as one Body. The image is the one allowed thing.\nATTACK_BODY = (\n    \"## Details\\n\\n\"\n    \"- **What:** a party\\n\\n\"\n    '<script>alert(\"pwned\")</script>\\n\\n'\n    '<iframe src=\"https://example.com/frame\"></iframe>\\n\\n'\n    '<form action=\"/admin/posts/1/delete\" method=\"post\"><button>Delete</button></form>\\n\\n'\n    '<p onclick=\"steal()\">Click <img src=\"x\" onerror=\"steal()\"></p>\\n\\n'\n    \"[Manage users](/admin/users)\\n\\n\"\n    \"![Three red circles](images/demo-illustration-1.svg)\\n\"\n)\n\nBODY_FRAGMENT = re.compile(r'<div class=\"body\">(.*?)</div>', re.S)\n\n\ndef body_html(html):\n    \"\"\"The rendered Body of a page: the same wrapper on Preview and on the public site.\"\"\"\n    match = BODY_FRAGMENT.search(html)\n    assert match, \"no rendered Body in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_to(client, path, **data):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token(client, \"/admin\")\n    return client.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef preview_post(client, title=\"Afrobeat Night\", body=ATTACK_BODY, **extra):\n    return post_to(client, \"/admin/posts/preview\", title=title, body=body, **extra)\n\n\ndef preview_page(client, page_id, body=ATTACK_BODY, **extra):\n    return post_to(client, f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/preview\", body=body, **extra)\n\n\ndef textarea_body(html):\n    import html as htmllib\n    return htmllib.unescape(re.search(r'<textarea[^>]*name=\"body\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>',\n                                      html, re.S).group(1))\n\n\n# -- Preview matches the published site ---------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"editor\", \"admin\"])\ndef test_post_preview_body_is_what_the_published_post_renders(role, client_as, db_path, tmp_path):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", ATTACK_BODY)\n    live = body_html(read(publish(db_path, tmp_path), \"posts/afrobeat-night.html\"))\n\n    response = preview_post(client_as(role))\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert body_html(response.text) == live\n    assert '<img alt=\"Three red circles\"' in live or 'alt=\"Three red circles\"' in live\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"editor\", \"admin\"])\ndef test_page_preview_body_is_what_the_published_page_renders(role, client_as, db_path, tmp_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\", ATTACK_BODY)\n    live = body_html(read(publish(db_path, tmp_path), \"photos.html\"))\n\n    response = preview_page(client_as(role), page_id)\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert body_html(response.text) == live\n    assert 'alt=\"Three red circles\"' in live\n\n\ndef test_preview_shows_the_title_and_uses_the_unsaved_text(client_as, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\", \"Old saved text\")\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n\n    post_preview = preview_post(editor, title=\"Unsaved Title\", body=\"Fresh **words**\")\n    page_preview = preview_page(editor, page_id, body=\"Fresh **words**\")\n\n    assert \"Unsaved Title\" in post_preview.text\n    assert \"<strong>words</strong>\" in post_preview.text\n    assert \"<strong>words</strong>\" in page_preview.text\n    assert \"Old saved text\" not in page_preview.text\n    assert \"Photos\" in page_preview.text                        # the Page's own title\n    assert pages.get(db_path, page_id)[\"body\"] == \"Old saved text\"      # nothing was saved\n\n\ndef test_preview_does_not_run_raw_html(client_as):\n    html = body_html(preview_post(client_as(\"editor\")).text)\n    for forbidden in (\"<script\", \"<iframe\", \"<form\", \"onclick\", \"onerror\", \"alert(\"):\n        assert forbidden not in html\n    assert 'src=\"images/demo-illustration-1.svg\"' not in html or \"../\" in html\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/users\"' not in html           # root-absolute links are dropped\n\n\ndef test_preview_images_load_from_the_approved_images_folder(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = preview_post(editor, body=\"![Three red circles](images/demo-illustration-1.svg)\")\n    src = re.search(r'<img[^>]*src=\"([^\"]+)\"', page.text).group(1)\n    base = re.search(r'<base href=\"([^\"]+)\"', page.text).group(1)\n    assert base.startswith(\"/admin/\")                  # the console serves the image, not the site\n\n    image = editor.get(\"/admin/preview/images/demo-illustration-1.svg\")\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"image/svg\")\n    assert src.endswith(\"images/demo-illustration-1.svg\")\n\n\ndef test_preview_image_route_refuses_anything_outside_the_images_folder(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for path in The image is the one allowed thing.\nATTACK_BODY = (\n    \"## Details\\n\\n\"\n    \"- **What:** a party\\n\\n\"\n    '<script>alert(\"pwned\")</script>\\n\\n'\n    '<iframe src=\"https://example.com/frame\"></iframe>\\n\\n'\n    '<form action=\"/admin/posts/1/delete\" method=\"post\"><button>Delete</button></form>\\n\\n'\n    '<p onclick=\"steal()\">Click <img src=\"x\" onerror=\"steal()\"></p>\\n\\n'\n    \"[Manage users](/admin/users)\\n\\n\"\n    \"![Three red circles](images/demo-illustration-1.svg)\\n\"\n)\n\nBODY_FRAGMENT = re.compile(r'<div class=\"body\">(.*?)</div>', re.S)\n\n\ndef body_html(html):\n    \"\"\"The rendered Body of a page: the same wrapper on Preview and on the public site.\"\"\"\n    match = BODY_FRAGMENT.search(html)\n    assert match, \"no rendered Body in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_to(client, path, **data):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token(client, \"/admin\")\n    return client.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef preview_post(client, title=\"Afrobeat Night\", body=ATTACK_BODY, **extra):\n    return post_to(client, \"/admin/posts/preview\", title=title, body=body, **extra)\n\n\ndef preview_page(client, page_id, body=ATTACK_BODY, **extra):\n    return post_to(client, f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/preview\", body=body, **extra)\n\n\ndef textarea_body(html):\n    import html as htmllib\n    return htmllib.unescape(re.search(r'<textarea[^>]*name=\"body\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>',\n                                      html, re.S).group(1))\n\n\n# -- Preview matches the published site ---------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"editor\", \"admin\"])\ndef test_post_preview_body_is_what_the_published_post_renders(role, client_as, db_path, tmp_path):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", ATTACK_BODY)\n    live = body_html(read(publish(db_path, tmp_path), \"posts/afrobeat-night.html\"))\n\n    response = preview_post(client_as(role))\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert body_html(response.text) == live\n    assert '<img alt=\"Three red circles\"' in live or 'alt=\"Three red circles\"' in live\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"editor\", \"admin\"])\ndef test_page_preview_body_is_what_the_published_page_renders(role, client_as, db_path, tmp_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\", ATTACK_BODY)\n    live = body_html(read(publish(db_path, tmp_path), \"photos.html\"))\n\n    response = preview_page(client_as(role), page_id)\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert body_html(response.text) == live\n    assert 'alt=\"Three red circles\"' in live\n\n\ndef test_preview_shows_the_title_and_uses_the_unsaved_text(client_as, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\", \"Old saved text\")\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n\n    post_preview = preview_post(editor, title=\"Unsaved Title\", body=\"Fresh **words**\")\n    page_preview = preview_page(editor, page_id, body=\"Fresh **words**\")\n\n    assert \"Unsaved Title\" in post_preview.text\n    assert \"<strong>words</strong>\" in post_preview.text\n    assert \"<strong>words</strong>\" in page_preview.text\n    assert \"Old saved text\" not in page_preview.text\n    assert \"Photos\" in page_preview.text                        # the Page's own title\n    assert pages.get(db_path, page_id)[\"body\"] == \"Old saved text\"      # nothing was saved\n\n\ndef test_preview_does_not_run_raw_html(client_as):\n    html = body_html(preview_post(client_as(\"editor\")).text)\n    for forbidden in (\"<script\", \"<iframe\", \"<form\", \"onclick\", \"onerror\", \"alert(\"):\n        assert forbidden not in html\n    assert 'src=\"images/demo-illustration-1.svg\"' not in html or \"../\" in html\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/users\"' not in html           # root-absolute links are dropped\n\n\ndef test_preview_images_load_from_the_approved_images_folder(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = preview_post(editor, body=\"![Three red circles](images/demo-illustration-1.svg)\")\n    src = re.search(r'<img[^>]*src=\"([^\"]+)\"', page.text).group(1)\n    base = re.search(r'<base href=\"([^\"]+)\"', page.text).group(1)\n    assert base.startswith(\"/admin/\")                  # the console serves the image, not the site\n\n    image = editor.get(\"/admin/preview/images/demo-illustration-1.svg\")\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"image/svg\")\n    assert src.endswith(\"images/demo-illustration-1.svg\")\n\n\ndef test_preview_image_route_refuses_anything_outside_the_images_folder(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for path in (\"../../.env\", \"..%2f..%2f.env\", \"%2e%2e/%2e%2e/pyproject.toml\",\n                 \"README.md\", \"nothing-here.png\"):\n        assert editor.get(f\"/admin/preview/images/{path}\").status_code in (400, 404)\n\n\n# -- Preview cannot be a way into Admin-only actions -----------------------------\n\ndef test_an_editors_preview_offers_no_admin_only_control(client_as, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\")\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for response in (preview_post(editor), preview_page(editor, page_id)):\n        assert response.status_code == 200\n        for admin_only in (\"/admin/users\", \"/delete\", \"/slug\", \"/title\", \"/unpublish\",\n                           \"Delete this\", \"Change the slug\", \"Mark Published\"):\n            assert admin_only not in response.text\n\n\ndef test_preview_ignores_fields_that_would_change_something(client_as, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\", \"Saved\", slug=\"hacked\", status=\"published\")\n    preview_post(editor, title=\"Afrobeat Night\", slug=\"hacked\", status=\"published\",\n                 post_id=str(post_id))\n\n    page = pages.get(db_path, page_id)\n    assert (page[\"title\"], page[\"slug\"], page[\"status\"], page[\"body\"]) == (\n        \"Photos\", \"photos\", \"draft\", \"Saved\")\n    post = posts.get(db_path, post_id)\n    assert (post[\"slug\"], post[\"status\"], post[\"body\"]) == (\"afrobeat-night\", \"draft\", \"Saved\")\n\n\ndef test_preview_needs_a_csrf_token(client_as, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\")\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    assert editor.post(\"/admin/posts/preview\", data={\"title\": \"T\", \"body\": \"B\"}).status_code == 403\n    assert editor.post(f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/preview\", data={\"body\": \"B\"}).status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_preview_sends_a_signed_out_visitor_to_sign_in(client, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\")\n    for path in (\"/admin/posts/preview\", f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/preview\"):\n        response = client.post(path, data={\"title\": \"T\", \"body\": \"B\"}, follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 303 and response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/preview/images/demo-illustration-1.svg\",\n                      follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_preview_of_a_missing_page_is_a_404_for_everyone_signed_in(client_as):\n    assert preview_page(client_as(\"editor\"), 9999).status_code == 404\n\n\n# -- The Event details hint -----------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_the_post_editor_shows_the_hint_but_never_puts_it_in_the_body(client_as, db_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for html in (editor.get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text,\n                 editor.get(f\"/admin/posts/{add_post(db_path, 'Afrobeat Night', 'My words')}/edit\").text):\n        hint = re.search(r'<aside[^>]*id=\"event-details-hint\".*?</aside>', html, re.S)\n        assert hint, \"no Event details hint\"\n        for word in (\"What\", \"When\", \"Where\", \"Who can attend\"):\n            assert word in hint.group(0)\n        assert \"What\" not in textarea_body(html)\n        assert \"Who can attend\" not in textarea_body(html)\n\n\ndef test_the_page_editor_has_no_event_details_hint(client_as, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\")\n    assert \"event-details-hint\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\").text\n\n\ndef test_hiding_the_hint_leaves_the_body_unchanged(client_as, db_path):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"My own words\", published=False)\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    before = editor.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\").text\n    assert \"event-details-hint\" in before\n\n    hidden = post_to(editor, \"/admin/posts/hint\", action=\"hide\", post_id=str(post_id),\n                     title=\"Afrobeat Night\", body=\"My own words\")\n    assert hidden.status_code == 200 and \"event-details-hint\" not in hidden.text\n\n    after = editor.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\").text\n    assert \"event-details-hint\" not in after            # stays hidden on the next visit\n    assert textarea_body(after) == textarea_body(before) == \"My own words\"\n    assert posts.get(db_path, post_id)[\"body\"] == \"My own words\"\n    assert \"event-details-hint\" not in editor.get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text\n\n\ndef test_hiding_the_hint_keeps_text_typed_but_not_yet_saved(client_as, db_path):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"Saved words\", published=False)\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n\n    hidden = post_to(editor, \"/admin/posts/hint\", action=\"hide\", post_id=str(post_id),\n                     title=\"Edited title\", body=\"Unsaved words\")\n\n    assert textarea_body(hidden.text) == \"Unsaved words\"\n    assert 'value=\"Edited title\"' in hidden.text\n    saved = posts.get(db_path, post_id)\n    assert (saved[\"title\"], saved[\"body\"]) == (\"Afrobeat Night\", \"Saved words\")\n\n\ndef test_the_hint_can_be_shown_again(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_to(editor, \"/admin/posts/hint\", action=\"hide\", title=\"\", body=\"\")\n    assert \"event-details-hint\" not in editor.get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text\n    shown = post_to(editor, \"/admin/posts/hint\", {"parentUuid":"2bed7ef5-5328-4ea4-8a42-a13ebf713d1c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyLMQUEiCPDdjCfBta61","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CdDWzcrStBc9ZxKMsRAjoG","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > app/routes/preview.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"Preview: the rendered, sanitized Body as the public page will show it.\n\nPreview calls the same `render_body` as the export, with the same roots, so what\nan Editor sees is what goes Live. It reads the text in the form and saves nothing,\nand it reads no other field, so it cannot be used to change a Post or a Page. Any\nsigned-in role may use it, and the page it returns has none of the Admin-only\ncontrols.\n\nThe images a Body points at (`images/<file>`) are shown by the console itself,\nfrom the same approved-images folder `cms publish` copies.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse\n\nfrom app import pages, settings\nfrom app.permissions import require\nfrom app.publish import is_approved_image\nfrom app.rendering import PAGE_ROOT, POST_ROOT, render_body\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\")\n\n\ndef _image_base(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The folder that holds `images/`, so a Body's relative image links resolve under /admin.\"\"\"\n    return request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_image\", path=\"\").removesuffix(\"images/\")\n\n\ndef _preview(request: Request, *, kind: str, title: str, body: str, root: str,\n             base: str):\n    return render(request, \"admin/preview.html\", title=f\"Preview of the {kind}\",\n                  user=request.state.user, kind=kind, page_title=title.strip() or \"(untitled)\",\n                  body_html=render_body(body, root=root), base_href=base)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/posts/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"preview.view\"))])\ndef preview_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    # A Post's page sits one folder down (posts/<slug>.html), as in the export.\n    return _preview(request, kind=\"Post\", title=title, body=body, root=POST_ROOT,\n                    base=_image_base(request) + \"posts/\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/pages/{page_id}/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"preview.view\"))])\ndef preview_page(request: Request, page_id: int, body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    # The title is the Page's saved title: an Editor cannot retitle a Page, so it is not a field.\n    page = pages.get(request.app.state.database, page_id)\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Page.\")\n    return _preview(request, kind=\"Page\", title=page[\"title\"], body=body, root=PAGE_ROOT,\n                    base=_image_base(request))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/preview/images/{path:path}\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"preview.view\"))])\ndef preview_image(path: str):\n    target = settings.IMAGES / path\n    if not is_approved_image(settings.IMAGES, target):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such image.\")\n    # A direct visit to an SVG must not run anything: sandbox it.\n    return FileResponse(target, headers={\"Content-Security-Policy\": \"sandbox\"})\nEOF\ncat > templates/admin/preview.html <<'EOF'\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block head %}<base href=\"{{ base_href }}\">{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p class=\"notice\" role=\"note\">Preview of the {{ kind }}. This is how it will look once it is Live.\n    Nothing has been saved or published. Close this tab to go back to the editor.</p>\n  <article class=\"prose\">\n    <h1>{{ page_title }}</h1>\n    <div class=\"body\">{{ body_html | safe }}</div>\n  </article>\n{% endblock %}\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\np='templates/base.html'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n''','''  {% block head %}{% endblock %}\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n''',1)\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\n\np='app/main.py'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace(\"from app.routes import admin, auth, pages, posts, users\",\"from app.routes import admin, auth, pages, posts, preview, users\")\ns=s.replace(\"    app.include_router(posts.router)\\n\",\"    # Before posts and pages: /admin/posts/preview must not be read as a Post id.\\n    app.include_router(preview.router)\\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\\n\")\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\n\np='app/routes/posts.py'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''def _form(request: Request, *, post=None, status_code=200, **context):\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", status_code=status_code,\n                  title=\"Edit Post\" if post else \"New Post\", user=request.state.user,\n                  post=post, **context)\n''','''HIDE_HINT = \"hide_event_hint\"\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, *, post=None, status_code=200, **context):\n    #    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"username\": username, \"password\": password,\n                                           \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client)},\n return tmp_path / \"demo.db\", result\n\n\ndef test_seed_runs_clean_from_env_example(demo):\n    path, result = demo\n    assert result.stderr == \"\"\n    assert path.exists()\n\n\ndef \".join(str(v) for table in (\"users\", \"posts\", \"pages\")\n                    for row in rows(path, f\"SELECT * FROM {table}\") for v in row\n                    if not str(v).startswith(\"$argon2\"))\n    assert \"@\" not in text                                        # no email addresses\n    assert \"demo placeholder\" in text.lower()\n    for claim in (\"founded\", \"president\", \"treasurer\", \"meets every\", \"since 19\", \"since 20\"):\n        assert claim not in text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_seed_passwords_are_hashed_and_never_printed(demo):\n    path, result = demo\n    for password in (env_example()[\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"], env_example()[\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"]):\n        assert password not in result.stdout + result.stderr\n        assert password.encode() not in path.read_bytes()\n    assert all(h.startswith(\"$argon2\") for (h,) in rows(path, \"SELECT password_hash FROM users\"))\n\n\ndef test_seed_can_run_again_without_changing_anything(demo, tmp_path):\n    path, _ = demo\n    before = rows(path, \"SELECT username, role, active, display_name FROM users\")\n    counts = rows(path, == before\n    assert rows(path, \"SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pages)\") == counts\n\n\ndef test_clean_setup_reaches_a_working_sign_in_as_both_roles(demo):\n    path, _  assert response.status_code == 303 and response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin\"\n        assert client.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef time.sleep(1.0)\n        h = call(\"Runtime.evaluate\", expression=\"document.documentElement.scrollHeight\")[\"result\"][\"value\"]\n        data = call(\"Page.captureScreenshot\", format=\"png\", A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = [\\\"topic.index\\\"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {\\\"kind\\\":\\\"project\\\",\\\"create\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"<title>\\\",\\\"doc\\\":{\\\"blocks\\\":{\\\"asof\\\":{\\\"type\\\":\\\"date\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"<today>\\\"},\\\"me\\\":{\\\"type\\\":\\\"mention\\\",\\\"user\\\":\\\"me\\\"},\\\"s1\\\":{\\\"type\\\":\\\"pending\\\",\\\"intent\\\":\\\"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to\\\"},\\\"s2\\\":{…}},\\\"markdown\\\":\\\"# <title>\\\\n\\\\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\\\\n\\\\n<?claude block s1?>\\\\n\\\\n<?claude block s2?>\\\"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = [\\\"topic.index\\\"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: \\\"<root id>\\\"`.\"],\"removedNames\":[]},\"type\":\"attachment\",\"uuid\":\"cc65f6ed-b2f2-498b-963e-eb2443f5e08b\",\"timestamp\":\"2026-10-12T04:47:36.508Z\",\"rendered\":[{\"content\":\"<system-reminder>\\n# MCP Server Instructions\\n\\nThe following MCP servers have provided instructions for how to use their tools and resources:\\n\\n## claude.ai Claude Docs\\nClaude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.\\n- mattpocock-skills:domain-modeling: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a CONTEXT.md, or recording or editing an ADR.\\n- mattpocock-skills:codebase-design: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.\\n- mattpocock-skills:code-review: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to \\\"review since X\\\".\\n- mattpocock-skills:resolving-merge-conflicts: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.\\n- mattpocock-skills:wizard: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.\\n- mattpocock-skills:grilling: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.\\n- mattpocock-skills:writing-for-agents: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.\\n- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: \\\"chart\\\", \\\"graph\\\", \\\"plot\\\", \\\"data viz\\\", \\\"visualization\\\", \\\"dashboard\\\", \\\"analytics\\\", \\\"visualize data\\\", \\\"categorical colors\\\", \\\"sequential / diverging palette\\\", \\\"stat tile\\\", \\\"sparkline\\\", \\\"heatmap\\\", \\\"legend\\\", \\\"axis\\\", \\\"toolti","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false,"persistedOutputPath":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/.claude/projects/-Users-yawoppong-krampah-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/a77ef331-d963-4153-904a-5fde226c3f3f/tool-results/bqzkitqpn.txt","persistedOutputSize":247983},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"69a8bcb9-2fe5-4ead-8f5f-7ce048ab0d74","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"b68357c6-d59e-4995-a597-7ee18ee605d2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a77ef331-d963-4153-904a-5fde226c3f3f","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"85b215ae-a17d-4f57-a73d-aed5b31802d8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyLg4Hpsx5yyAk65Lqa8","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013R6oqjkYL8SFozr1rVZmRW","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > docs/release-checklist.md <<'EOF'\n# Release checklist\n\nHow Published content becomes **Live**. Marking a Post or Page Published in the admin\nconsole only makes it ready; visitors see it after `cms publish` and `cms deploy`.\n\n**Who runs it.** For the class demo, the project author runs this from their own laptop.\nASA has no known person responsible for this step, and none is assumed. This checklist\ndescribes no ASA approval process either: Photo permission below is a working rule for\nthis project, not an ASA policy.\n\n## 1. Before you publish\n\n- [ ] **Photo permission.** If a Post or Page shows a real photo, an ASA leader has\n      confirmed that ASA has permission to use it. Do this *before* the file is added.\n      Without confirmation, use a demo illustration or no image. The Photos page says\n      that actual event photos will be added once ASA has permission.\n- [ ] **Adding approved image files.** Copy each approved file into `images/`\n      (`.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.webp` or `.svg`; hidden files and other file\n      types are never copied). `cms publish` copies them to `site/images/`.\n- [ ] **The limit.** An Editor cannot add an image file alone. An Editor writes the\n      caption, the alt text and the Markdown reference (`![Alt text](images/file.jpg)`);\n      the release-holder adds the file. A reference to a file that is not in `images/`\n      shows only its alt text on the live site.\n- [ ] Every image has descriptive alt text, and demo illustrations are labelled\n      illustrative, never presented as photos of a real ASA event.\n\n## 2. Publish and check\n\n- [ ] `uv run --env-file .env cms publish` writes `site/` from Published content only.\n      Drafts never leave the database. Never edit `site/` by hand: it is rebuilt.\n- [ ] **Relative-path check.** This must print nothing:\n\n      grep -rEn '(href|src)=\"/' site/\n\n      The site is served from a subfolder, so a root-absolute link or image would break.\n- [ ] Look at it before it goes out: `python3 -m http.server -d site 8001`, then open\n      http://localhost:8001. Check the Navigation, the newest Announcement, and each image.\n\n## 3. Deploy and confirm\n\n- [ ] `uv run --env-file .env cms deploy` pushes `site/` to the `gh-pages` branch.\n- [ ] Wait up to ten minutes, then open the Live URL (in the README) and find the change.\n      Only now is it Live.\n\n## Before anyone else can reach the console\n\nThe console is meant to run only on the author's laptop and never on the public internet\n(ADR-001). If that ever changes, do these first.\n\n- [ ] Set a long random `CMS_SECRET_KEY` in `.env`. `cms serve` warns while the key is one\n      that is public in this repository.\n- [ ] Choose your own passwords in `.env` instead of the `change-me-...` placeholders from\n      `.env.example`. `scripts/seed_demo.py` says so while a placeholder is in use.\n\n## Known limits, accepted for the class demo\n\nThese were raised as follow-ups on the T01 and T04 reviews. They are accepted because the\nconsole runs only on the author's laptop, and recorded here so no one is surprised.\n\n- **Sessions are signed cookies with no server-side record.** A copied cookie stays valid\n  after sign-out until it expires (8 hours) or the account is Deactivated.\n- **A Password reset does not end sessions that are already signed in.** Deactivating the\n  account does. To close both gaps later: keep a per-account session version and check it\n  in `security.current_user`, bumping it on sign-out and on reset.\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nreadme = '''# IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2: ASA website CMS\n\nA small web CMS for the African Student Association (ASA) at Kenyon, built for a class\nproject. A local admin console (FastAPI, Jinja, SQLite) is where an Admin and Editors write\nPosts and Pages. `cms publish` renders only Published content into `site/` as plain HTML,\nand `cms deploy` sends it to GitHub Pages. The console never goes on the public internet.\nWords such as Post, Published and Live are defined in `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n## Live URL\n\nhttps://yawoppongkrampah-hub.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\n\nRepository: https://github.com/yawoppongkrampah-hub/iphs400-mp2-cms\n\nThe demo content is placeholder text and makes no claim about ASA beyond the client brief.\n\n## Run locally\n\nYou need [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and Python 3.12 or newer.\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/yawoppongkrampah-hub/iphs400-mp2-cms.git\ncd iphs400-mp2-cms\nuv sync\ncp .env.example .env\nuv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py\nuv run --env-file .env cms serve\n```\n\nOpen http://localhost:8000/admin and sign in as `admin` or `editor`, with the matching\n`CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` or `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` from `.env`. The seed also creates one\nDeactivated account (`former-member`) that cannot sign in, plus Published and Draft Posts\nand Pages. Run the seed again at any time; it never duplicates anything.\n\n`.env` is not loaded automatically, so keep `--env-file .env` on every `uv run`. `.env`,\n`*.db` and `site/` are in `.gitignore` and are never committed.\n\nTo start with your own first Admin instead of the demo accounts, set `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD`\nand run `uv run --env-file .env cms create-admin --username NAME --display-name \"ASA Leadership\"`.\nThe password is read from the environment and never printed.\n\n```bash\nuv run --env-file .env cms publish   # write site/ from Published content\nuv run --env-file .env cms deploy    # push site/ to the gh-pages branch\nuv run pytest -q                     # the test suite\nuv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2\n```\n\nMaking content Live is a short, repeatable routine: see `docs/release-checklist.md`. It also\nlists what must change before anyone else can reach the console, and the session limits that\nare accepted for the class demo.\n\n## What is here\n\n```text\napp/, templates/   the CMS: routes, rules, rendering, admin and public templates\nscripts/           seed_demo.py, usage_report.py, check_submission.py\nimages/            approved image files; `cms publish` copies them into the site\ntests/             tests at three seams: the admin console, the published site, the cms command\ndocs/              ADRs, the release checklist, screenshots, handoffs, transcripts\nnotes/             field notes, token budget plan, usage ledger\n```\n\nScreenshots of the six admin screens at 1280 px and 390 px are in `docs/screenshots/`.\n\n## Generative AI Use Statement\n\n**Models.** Claude Sonnet 5 and Sonnet 5.5, through Claude Code on a Claude Pro account.\n**Skills.** The mattpocock-skills plugin: `setup-matt-pocock-skills`, `ask-matt`, `grilling`,\n`domain-modeling`, `to-spec`, `to-tickets`, `tdd`, `implement`, `code-review` and `handoff`.\nThe process was grill, spec, eight tickets, then one ticket per session, each ending in a\n`/code-review` comment on its issue before the closing commit.\n\n**Two prompts I really sent** (from the session transcripts in `docs/transcripts/`):\n\n> Choose (b). Editors should be able to update the body of existing Pages so the Photos page can stay current. The admin should control creating and deleting Pages, publishing or unpublishing them, and changing titles or slugs that affect navigation and links. This is a design choice for our ASA site, not something I observed in WordPress.\n\n> Before creating tickets, edit spec issue #1. In the Problem Statement, remove the unverified claim \"Today ASA has no site that does this.\" Do not replace it with another claim about ASA's current website or communication. Change \"find upcoming events\" to \"find event announcements,\" since this version has no event-date field or automatic upcoming/past sorting. Keep the rest of the spec as written. Show me the revised Problem Statement and confirm the issue was updated.\n\n**One real model failure.** The first draft of the spec, written by the model, stated as fact\nthat \"Today ASA has no site that does this.\" Nothing in the client brief says that, and I had\nnever checked it. I caught it when I read the draft and had it removed before any ticket was\nwritten, along with \"upcoming events\", which promised sorting this version does not build.\nThe rule that no claim about ASA goes beyond the brief is now in `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n### Backends used\n\n| Provider | Model | Used for | Commit trailer |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Anthropic | Sonnet 5 / Sonnet 5.5 | Everything: grill, spec, tickets, all implementation and reviews | none needed |\n\nNo other backend was used. The `provider` column of `notes/usage-ledger.csv` says `anthropic`\non every row, and no commit has a `Backend:` trailer.\n'''\nopen('README.md','w').write(readme)\nEOF\ngrep -n \"no claim\\|brief\" CONTEXT.md | head -3","description":"Write release checklist and README"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1256,"cache_read_input_tokens":146118,"output_tokens":4711,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":1428},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1256,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":4711,"cache_read_input_tokens":146118,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1256,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1256},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_013R6oqjkYL8SFozr1rVZmRW":{"command":"cd /Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && cat > docs/release-checklist.md <<'EOF'\n# Release checklist\n\nHow Published content becomes **Live**.
