clean_copy(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"A clean checkout in a temp folder, with `.env` copied from `.env.example`.\"\"\"\n    repo = tmp_path / \"repo\"\n    repo.mkdir()\n    for name in COPIED:\n        shutil.copytree(ROOT / name, repo / name,\n                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(\"__pycache__\"))\n    shutil.copy(ROOT / \".env.example\", repo / \".env.example\")\n    shutil.copy(repo / \".env.example\", repo / \".env\")        # the rubric's `cp .env.example .env`\n    return repo\n\n\ndef env_without_cms(repo, **extra):\n    \"\"\"The shell a grader has: no CMS_* variables, the clean copy's code first on the path.\"\"\"\n    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(\"CMS_\")}\n    env[\"PYTHONPATH\"] = str(repo)\n    env.update(extra)\n    return env\n\n\ndef run_python(repo, *args, **extra_env):\n    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, *args], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True,\n                          env=env_without_cms(repo, **extra_env))\n\n\ndef example(name):\n    for line in (ROOT / \".env.example\").read_text().splitlines():\n        if line.startswith(f\"{name}=\"):\n            return line.partition(\"=\")[2].strip().strip('\"')\n\n\ndef sign_in(db, username, password):\n    client = TestClient(create_app(database=db))\n    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"username\": username, \"password\": password,\n                                           \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client)},\n                           follow_redirects=False)\n    return response.status_code == 303\n\n\ndef rewrite_env(repo, **values):\n    text = (repo / \".env\").read_text()\n    for name, value in values.items():\n        text = re.sub(rf\"(?m)^{name}=.*$\", f\"{name}={value}\", text)\n    (repo / \".env\").write_text(text)\n\n\n# -- the rubric's commands ---------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_seed_works_after_copying_env_example_with_no_env_file_flag(clean_copy):\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    db = clean_copy / \"cms.db\"\n    assert db.exists()\n    assert sign_in(db, \"admin\", example(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"))\n    assert sign_in(db, \"editor\", example(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"))\n\n\ndef test_create_admin_works_with_no_env_file_flag(clean_copy):\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"-m\", \"app.cli\", \"create-admin\", \"--username\", \"boss\",\n                        \"--display-name\", \"ASA Leadership\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    assert sign_in(clean_copy / \"cms.db\", \"boss\", example(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"))\n\n\ndef test_other_settings_come_from_dotenv_too(clean_copy):\n    rewrite_env(clean_copy, CMS_SITE_TITLE='\"A Title From The File\"')\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"-c\", \"from app import settings; print(settings.SITE_TITLE)\")\n    assert result.stdout.strip() == \"A Title From The File\"\n\n\ndef test_a_clone_with_no_dotenv_still_starts_with_the_defaults(clean_copy):\n    (clean_copy / \".env\").unlink()\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"-c\", \"from app import settings; print(settings.SITE_TITLE)\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip() == \"African Student Association\"\n\n\n# -- environment wins, secrets stay quiet --------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_a_variable_in_the_real_environment_wins_over_dotenv(clean_copy):\n    rewrite_env(clean_copy, CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=\"password-from-the-file-1\")\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\",\n                        CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=\"password-from-the-environment-2\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    db = clean_copy / \"cms.db\"\n    assert sign_in(db, \"admin\", \"password-from-the-environment-2\")\n    assert not sign_in(db, \"admin\", \"password-from-the-file-1\")\n\n\ndef test_the_environment_can_point_at_another_database(clean_copy, tmp_path):\n    elsewhere = tmp_path / \"elsewhere.db\"\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\", CMS_DATABASE=str(elsewhere))\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    assert elsewhere.exists() and not (clean_copy / \"cms.db\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_loading_dotenv_never_prints_a_secret(clean_copy):\n    rewrite_env(clean_copy, CMS_SECRET_KEY=\"a-very-secret-signing-key-0123456789\",\n                CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=\"admin-secret-passphrase-1\",\n                CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=\"editor-secret-passphrase-2\")\n    seed = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\")\n    serve = run_python(clean_copy, \"-c\",\n                       \"from app import settings; from app.cli import main; print('ok')\")\n    for result in (seed, serve):\n        shown = result.stdout + result.stderr\n        for secret in (\"a-very-secret-signing-key-0123456789\", \"admin-secret-passphrase-1\",\n                       \"editor-secret-passphrase-2\"):\n            assert secret not in shown\n    assert b\"admin-secret-passphrase-1\" not in (clean_copy / \"cms.db\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef test_the_loader_package_is_already_locked_so_no_dependency_was_added():\n    lock = (ROOT / \"uv.lock\").read_text()\n    assert 'name = \"python-dotenv\"' in lock\n    declared = (ROOT / \"pyproject.toml\").read_text()\n    assert \"uvicorn[standard]\" in declared            # the declared package that brings it variables, the clean copy's code first on the path.\"\"\"\n    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(\"CMS_\")}\n    env[\"PYTHONPATH\"] = str(repo)\n    env.update(extra)\n    return env\n\n\ndef run_python(repo, *args, **extra_env):\n    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, *args], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True,\n                          env=env_without_cms(repo, **extra_env))\n\n\ndef example(name):\n    for line in (ROOT / \".env.example\").read_text().splitlines():\n        if line.startswith(f\"{name}=\"):\n            return line.partition(\"=\")[2].strip().strip('\"')\n\n\ndef sign_in(db, username, password):\n    client = TestClient(create_app(database=db))\n    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"username\": username, \"password\": password,\n                                           \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client)},\n                           follow_redirects=False)\n    return response.status_code == 303\n\n\ndef rewrite_env(repo, **values):\n    text = (repo / \".env\").read_text()\n    for name, value in values.items():\n        text = re.sub(rf\"(?m)^{name}=.*$\", f\"{name}={value}\", text)\n    (repo / \".env\").write_text(text)\n\n\n# -- the rubric's commands ---------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_seed_works_after_copying_env_example_with_no_env_file_flag(clean_copy):\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    db = clean_copy / \"cms.db\"\n    assert db.exists()\n    assert sign_in(db, \"admin\", example(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"))\n    assert sign_in(db, \"editor\", example(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"))\n\n\ndef test_create_admin_works_with_no_env_file_flag(clean_copy):\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"-m\", \"app.cli\", \"create-admin\", \"--username\", \"boss\",\n                        \"--display-name\", \"ASA Leadership\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    assert sign_in(clean_copy / \"cms.db\", \"boss\", example(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"))\n\n\ndef test_other_settings_come_from_dotenv_too(clean_copy):\n    rewrite_env(clean_copy, CMS_SITE_TITLE='\"A Title From The File\"')\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"-c\", \"from app import settings; print(settings.SITE_TITLE)\")\n    assert result.stdout.strip() == \"A Title From The File\"\n\n\ndef test_a_clone_with_no_dotenv_still_starts_with_the_defaults(clean_copy):\n    (clean_copy / \".env\").unlink()\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"-c\", \"from app import settings; print(settings.SITE_TITLE)\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip() == \"African Student Association\"\n\n\n# -- environment wins, secrets stay quiet --------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_a_variable_in_the_real_environment_wins_over_dotenv(clean_copy):\n    rewrite_env(clean_copy, CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=\"password-from-the-file-1\")\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\",\n                        CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=\"password-from-the-environment-2\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    db = clean_copy / \"cms.db\"\n    assert sign_in(db, \"admin\", \"password-from-the-environment-2\")\n    assert not sign_in(db, \"admin\", \"password-from-the-file-1\")\n\n\ndef test_the_environment_can_point_at_another_database(clean_copy, tmp_path):\n    elsewhere = tmp_path / \"elsewhere.db\"\n    result = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\", CMS_DATABASE=str(elsewhere))\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    assert elsewhere.exists() and not (clean_copy / \"cms.db\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_loading_dotenv_never_prints_a_secret(clean_copy):\n    rewrite_env(clean_copy, CMS_SECRET_KEY=\"a-very-secret-signing-key-0123456789\",\n                CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=\"admin-secret-passphrase-1\",\n                CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=\"editor-secret-passphrase-2\")\n    seed = run_python(clean_copy, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\")\n    serve = run_python(clean_copy, \"-c\",\n                       \"from app import settings; from app.cli import main; print('ok')\")\n    for result in (seed, serve):\n        shown = result.stdout + result.stderr\n        for secret in (\"a-very-secret-signing-key-0123456789\", \"admin-secret-passphrase-1\",\n                       \"editor-secret-passphrase-2\"):\n            assert secret not in shown\n    assert b\"admin-secret-passphrase-1\" not in (clean_copy / \"cms.db\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef test_the_loader_package_is_already_locked_so_no_dependency_was_added():\n    lock = (ROOT / \"uv.lock\").read_text()\n    assert 'name = \"python-dotenv\"' in lock\n    declared = (ROOT / \"pyproject.toml\").read_text()\n    assert \"uvicorn[standard]\" in declared            # the declared {"parentUuid":"aeb564b6-a895-4cac-8068-0d490e31c31a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfySHBv2SBcaGE6G6eR7p","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015XGZDD1iqPD2vq6ZdiUnxN","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t09_feedback.py","content":"\"\"\"T09: persistent admin navigation, and clear feedback after every action.\n\nSeam 1 (the admin console over HTTP). What a signed-in person sees after they\nact: a status message once, a clear error page instead of raw JSON, and the same\nnavigation on every admin screen.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import pages, posts\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_token\nfrom tests.test_t03_publish import add_post, author_id\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import add_page\n\nSTATUS = re.compile(r'<p[^>]*role=\"status\"[^>]*>(.*?)</p>', re.S)\nNAV = re.compile(r'<nav aria-label=\"Admin\">(.*?)</nav>', re.S)\nLINKS = re.compile(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef status_text(html):\n    match = STATUS.search(html)\n    return \" \".join(match.group(1).split()) if match else None\n\n\ndef post_to(client, path, **data):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token(client, \"/admin\")\n    return client.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=True)\n\n\ndef nav_of(html):\n    match = NAV.search(html)\n    assert match, \"no admin navigation on this screen\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# -- the same navigation on every admin screen -------------------------------------\n\ndef screens(db_path):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", published=False)\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\")\n    return [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/posts/new\",\n            f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\", \"/admin/pages\", f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\"]\n\n\ndef test_every_screen_has_the_navigation_with_a_working_sign_out(client_as, db_path):\n    for role in (\"editor\", \"admin\"):\n        client = client_as(role)\n        for url in screens(db_path) + ([\"/admin/users\", \"/admin/users/new\", \"/admin/users/1\"]\n                                       if role == \"admin\" else []):\n            response = client.get(url)\n            assert response.status_code == 200, url\n            nav = nav_of(response.text)\n            for expected in (\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/pages\"):\n                assert f'href=\"{expected}\"' in nav, (role, url, expected)\n            assert 'action=\"/logout\"' in nav and 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in nav, (role, url)\n\n\ndef test_the_accounts_link_is_there_for_the_admin_and_never_for_an_editor(client_as, db_path):\n    for url in screens(db_path):\n        assert 'href=\"/admin/users\"' in nav_of(client_as(\"admin\").get(url).text)\n        assert \"/admin/users\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_the_navigation_also_shows_on_the_refusal_page_and_the_preview(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    refused = editor.get(\"/admin/users\")\n    assert refused.status_code == 403 and 'href=\"/admin/posts\"' in nav_of(refused.text)\n    preview = post_to(editor, \"/admin/posts/preview\", title=\"T\", body=\"B\")\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/content\"' in nav_of(preview.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_sign_in_page_has_no_navigation(client):\n    assert NAV.search(client.get(\"/login\").text) is None\n\n\ndef test_signing_out_from_the_navigation_works_from_any_screen(client_as, db_path):\n    client = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_to(client, \"/logout\")\n    assert 'name=\"password\"' in response.text\n    assert client.get(\"/admin\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303\n\n\n# -- success is said once ----------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_signing_out_says_so_on_the_sign_in_page(client_as):\n    assert \"signed out\" in status_text(post_to(client_as(\"editor\"), \"/logout\").text).lower()\n\n\ndef test_a_message_is_shown_once_not_on_every_later_screen(client_as):\n    client = client_as(\"editor\")\n    saved = post_to(client, \"/admin/posts\", title=\"Afrobeat Night\", body=\"Body\")\n    assert status_text(saved.text)\n    assert status_text(client.get(\"/admin/posts\").text) is None\n\n\nPOST_ACTIONS = [\n    (\"create\", \"Draft\"),\n    (\"save\", \"saved\"),\n    (\"publish\", \"Published\"),\n    (\"unpublish\", \"Draft\"),\n]\n\n\ndef test_post_actions_each_say_what_happened(client_as, db_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    created = post_to(editor, \"/admin/posts\", title=\"Afrobeat Night\", body=\"Body\")\n    post_id = int(re.search(r\"/admin/posts/(\\d+)/edit\", str(created.url)).group(1))\n    assert \"draft\" in status_text(created.text).lower()\n\n    saved = post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Afrobeat Night\", body=\"New body\")\n    assert \"saved\" in status_text(saved.text).lower()\n\n    published = post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/publish\")\n    message = status_text(published.text).lower()\n    assert \"published\" in message and \"not live\" in message      # Published is not Live\n\n    unpublished = post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\")\n    assert \"draft\" in status_text(unpublished.text).lower()\n\n\ndef test_admin_post_actions_slug_and_delete_say_what_happened(client_as, db_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", published=False)\n    slug = post_to(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/slug\", slug=\"new-link\")\n    assert \"slug\" in status_text(slug.text).lower()\n    deleted = post_to(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\")\n    assert \"deleted\" in status_text(deleted.text).lower()\n    assert str(deleted.url).endswith(\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef test_page_actions_each_say_what_happened(client_as, db_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    created = post_to(admin, \"/admin/pages\", title=\"Zeta\", slug=\"zeta\", body=\"Body\")\n    page_id = int(re.search(r\"/admin/pages/(\\d+)/edit\", str(created.url)).group(1))\n    assert \"created\" in status_text(created.text).lower()\n    steps = [\n        (f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}\", {\"body\": \"More\"}, \"saved\"),\n        (f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/title\", {\"title\": \"Zeta Two\"}, \"title\"),\n        (f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/slug\", {\"slug\": \"zeta-two\"}, \"slug\"),\n        (f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/publish\", {}, \"published\"),\n        (f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/unpublish\", {}, \"draft\"),\n        (f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/delete\", {}, \"deleted\"),\n    ]\n    for path, data, word in steps:\n        assert word in status_text(post_to(admin, path, **data).text).lower(), path\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_saving_a_page_body_sees_that_it_saved(client_as, db_path):\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\")\n    saved = post_to(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}\", body=\"Fresh words\")\n    assert \"saved\" in status_text(saved.text).lower()\n\n\ndef test_account_actions_each_say_what_happened(client_as, db_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    created = post_to(admin, \"/admin/users\", username=\"newbie\", password=\"newbie-password-1\",\n                      role=\"editor\", display_name=\"New Person\")\n    user_id = int(re.search(r\"/admin/users/(\\d+)\", str(created.url)).group(1))\n    assert \"created\" in status_text(created.text).lower()\n    steps = [\n        (f\"/admin/users/{user_id}/role\", {\"role\": \"admin\"}, \"role\"),\n        (f\"/admin/users/{user_id}/display-name\", {\"display_name\": \"ASA Events Team\"}, \"display name\"),\n        (f\"/admin/users/{user_id}/password\", {\"password\": \"brand-new-passphrase-9\"}, \"password\"),\n        (f\"/admin/users/{user_id}/deactivate\", {}, \"deactivated\"),\n        (f\"/admin/users/{user_id}/reactivate\", {}, \"reactivated\"),\n    ]\n    for path, data, word in steps:\n        message = status_text(post_to(admin, path, **data).text).lower()\n        assert word in message, (path, message)\n\n\ndef test_a_password_reset_message_never_contains_the_password(client_as, db_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_to(admin, \"/admin/users/2/password\", password=\"never-show-this-passphrase\")\n    assert status_text(response.text)\n    assert \"never-show-this-passphrase\" not in response.text\n\n\n# -- failure is said clearly ------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_a_failed_save_says_why_and_keeps_the_text(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").post(\n        \"/admin/posts\", data={\"title\": \"\", \"body\": \"Keep these words\",\n                              \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client_as(\"editor\"), \"/admin\")})\n    assert response.status_code in (400, 403)\n\n\ndef test_a_missing_token_is_a_readable_page_not_raw_json(client_as):\n    client = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = client.post(\"/admin/posts\", data={\"title\": \"T\", \"body\": \"B\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/html\")\n    assert \"token\" in response.text.lower() and 'href=\"/admin\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_a_missing_item_is_a_readable_page_with_a_way_back(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/posts/9999/edit\")\n    assert response.status_code == 404\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/html\")\n    assert \"no such post\" in response.text.lower() and 'href=\"/admin/posts\"' in nav_of(response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_missing_token_at_sign_in_is_a_readable_page(client):\n    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"username\": \"admin\", \"password\": \"x\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/html\")\n    assert 'href=\"/login\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_the_same_failure_for_a_missing_page_account(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for url, text in ((\"/admin/pages/9999/edit\", \"no such page\"),\n                      (\"/admin/users/9999\", \"no such account\")):\n        response = admin.get(url)\n        assert response.status_code == 404 and text in app import pages, posts\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_token\nfrom tests.test_t03_publish import add_post, author_id\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import add_page\n\nSTATUS = re.compile(r'<p[^>]*role=\"status\"[^>]*>(.*?)</p>', re.S)\nNAV = re.compile(r'<nav aria-label=\"Admin\">(.*?)</nav>', re.S)\nLINKS = re.compile(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef status_text(html):\n    match = STATUS.search(html)\n    return \" \".join(match.group(1).split()) if match else None\n\n\ndef post_to(client, path, **data):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = screen\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# -- the same navigation on every admin screen -------------------------------------\n\ndef screens(db_path):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", published=False)\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", \"photos\")\n    return [\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/posts/new\",\n            f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\", \"/admin/pages\", f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\"]\n\n\ndef test_every_screen_has_the_navigation_with_a_working_sign_out(client_as, db_path):\n    for role in (\"editor\", \"admin\"):\n        client = client_as(role)\n        for url in screens(db_path) + ([\"/admin/users\", \"/admin/users/new\", \"/admin/users/1\"]\n                                       if role == \"admin\" else []):\n            response = client.get(url)\n            assert response.status_code == 200, url\n            nav = nav_of(response.text)\n            for expected in (\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/pages\"):\n                assert f'href=\"{expected}\"' in nav, (role, url, expected)\n            assert 'action=\"/logout\"' in nav and 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in nav, (role, url)\n\n\ndef test_the_accounts_link_is_there_for_the_admin_and_never_for_an_editor(client_as, db_path):\n    for url in screens(db_path):\n        assert {"parentUuid":"d73d36df-569f-4a78-ae2e-a114fd566eb2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfySKaZcMv1EGbnqSynpC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HkczBwRRNHp6WhJidAUvvh","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > tests/test_t09_mobile.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"T09: phone width, measured in a real browser, and screenshots taken at real widths.\n\n`scripts/admin_screenshots.py` starts the console on a throwaway seeded database,\nloads every admin screen in headless Chrome at 390 px and 1280 px, and measures\nwhether the page is wider than the screen. The browser test is skipped when Chrome\nis not installed; the screenshot-file test needs no browser.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSHOTS = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\"\nSCREENS = [\"login\", \"dashboard\", \"content-list\", \"editor\", \"users\", \"editor-denied\"]\nNO_BROWSER = 77\n\n\ndef png_size(path):\n    header = path.read_bytes()[:24]\n    assert header[:8] == b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\", f\"{path.name} is not a PNG\"\n    return struct.unpack(\">II\", header[16:24])\n\n\ndef test_no_admin_screen_is_wider_than_a_390_px_phone():\n    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"admin_screenshots.py\"),\n                             \"--check-only\"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=240)\n    if result.returncode == NO_BROWSER:\n        pytest.skip(\"Chrome is not installed\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    assert \"390 px\" in result.stdout and \"OVERFLOW\" not in result.stdout\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"screen\", SCREENS)\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"width\", [1280, 390])\ndef test_each_required_screenshot_is_a_full_page_at_its_real_width(screen, width):\n    path = SHOTS / f\"{screen}-{width}.png\"\n    assert path.exists(), f\"missing {path.name}\"\n    pixel_width, pixel_height = png_size(path)\n    # A page that overflowed would make a wider image, because the script never crops\n    # narrower than the page. A width that equals the viewport means it fitted.\n    assert pixel_width == width, f\"{path.name} is {pixel_width} px wide\"\n    assert pixel_height >= 400, f\"{path.name} is only {pixel_height} px tall\"\nEOF\necho ok","description":"Write mobile and screenshot tests"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2510,"cache_read_input_tokens":347353,"output_tokens":1151,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":183},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2510,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1151,"cache_read_input_tokens":347353,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2510,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2510},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01HkczBwRRNHp6WhJidAUvvh":{"command":"cd /Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && cat > tests/test_t09_mobile.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"T09: phone width, measured in a real browser, and screenshots taken at real widths.\n\n`scripts/admin_screenshots.py` starts the console on a throwaway seeded database,\nloads every admin screen in headless Chrome at 390 px and 1280 px, and measures\nwhether the page is wider than the screen. {"parentUuid":"575536a6-2b2d-4666-a5ef-9139c88156ba","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyScAmMHX875udqFxhqr","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BXrAWJw7dF4f6Uu9qXpNPR","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/admin_screenshots.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Measure the admin console at phone width and take the six required screenshots.\n\n    uv run python scripts/admin_screenshots.py                 # write docs/screenshots/\n    uv run python scripts/admin_screenshots.py --check-only    # only measure, write nothing\n\nIt starts the console on a throwaway database (never your own), signs in over HTTP,\nand loads each screen in headless Chrome at 390 px and 1280 px. A screen \"overflows\"\nwhen the page is wider than the viewport. A screenshot is never cropped narrower than\nthe page, so a page that overflowed shows up as an image wider than its viewport.\n\nExit codes: 0 all fit, 1 something overflows, 77 Chrome was not found (nothing was run).\nUses `websockets` and `httpx`, which the project already installs (uvicorn[standard], dev group).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport base64\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport secrets\nimport shutil\nimport signal\nimport socket\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nimport time\nimport urllib.request\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport httpx\nfrom websockets.sync.client import connect\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nNO_BROWSER = 77\nWIDTHS = (1280, 390)\nCHROME_PATHS = [\n    \"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome\",\n    \"/Applications/Chromium.app/Contents/MacOS/Chromium\",\n    \"google-chrome\", \"google-chrome-stable\", \"chromium\", \"chromium-browser\",\n]\nTOKEN = re.compile(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"')\n\n\ndef find_chrome() -> str | None:\n    for candidate in [os.environ.get(\"CHROME\")] + CHROME_PATHS:\n        if candidate and (Path(candidate).exists() or shutil.which(candidate)):\n            return candidate\n    return None\n\n\ndef free_port() -> int:\n    with socket.socket() as sock:\n        sock.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n        return sock.getsockname()[1]\n\n\nclass Console:\n    \"\"\"The admin console on a throwaway seeded database.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, workdir: Path):\n        self.port = free_port()\n        self.base = f\"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}\"\n        self.passwords = {\"admin\": secrets.token_urlsafe(12), \"editor\": secrets.token_urlsafe(12)}\n        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(\"CMS_\")}\n        env.update(CMS_DATABASE=str(workdir / \"shots.db\"), CMS_SECRET_KEY=secrets.token_urlsafe(32),\n                   CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=self.passwords[\"admin\"],\n                   CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=self.passwords[\"editor\"], PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT))\n        subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\")], cwd=ROOT, env=env,\n                       check=True, capture_output=True)\n        self.process = subprocess.Popen(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"uvicorn\", \"app.main:app\", \"--port\", str(self.port),\n             \"--log-level\", \"warning\"], cwd=ROOT, env=env, start_new_session=True,\n            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)\n        for _ in range(100):\n            try:\n                httpx.get(self.base + \"/login\")\n                return\n            except httpx.TransportError:\n                time.sleep(0.2)\n        raise RuntimeError(\"the console did not start\")\n\n    def cookie(self, user: str) -> str:\n        client = httpx.Client(base_url=self.base)\n        token = TOKEN.search(client.get(\"/login\").text).group(1)\n        client.post(\"/login\", data={\"username\": user, \"password\": self.passwords[user],\n                                    \"csrf_token\": token})\n        return client.cookies.get(\"cms_session\")\n\n    def stop(self) -> None:\n        os.killpg(self.process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)\n\n\nclass Browser:\n    def __init__(self, chrome: str):\n        self.profile = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=\"shots-profile-\")\n        port = free_port()\n        self.process = subprocess.Popen(\n            [chrome, \"--headless=new\", f\"--remote-debugging-port={port}\", \"--no-first-run\",\n             \"--hide-scrollbars\", \"--force-device-scale-factor=1\",\n             f\"--user-data-dir={self.profile}\", \"about:blank\"],\n            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)\n        for _ in range(100):\n            try:\n                tabs = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json\"))\n                break\n            except OSError:\n                time.sleep(0.2)\n        else:\n            raise RuntimeError(\"Chrome did not start\")\n        self.socket = connect(next(t for t in tabs if t[\"type\"] == \"page\")[\"webSocketDebuggerUrl\"],\n                              max_size=None)\n        self.counter = 0\n        self.call(\"Page.enable\")\n        self.call(\"Network.enable\")\n\n    def call(self, method: str, **params):\n        self.counter += 1\n        self.socket.send(json.dumps({\"id\": self.counter, \"method\": method, \"params\": params}))\n        while True:\n            message = json.loads(self.socket.recv())\n            if message.get(\"id\") == self.counter:\n                return message.get(\"result\", {})\n\n    def measure(self, url: str, cookie: str | None, base: str, width: int) -> dict:\n        self.call(\"Network.clearBrowserCookies\")\n        if cookie:\n            self.call(\"Network.setCookie\", name=\"cms_session\", value=cookie, url=base, httpOnly=True)\n        self.call(\"Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride\", width=width, height=900,\n                  deviceScaleFactor=1, mobile=False)\n        self.call(\"Page.navigate\", url=url)\n        time.sleep(1.2)\n        expression = (\"JSON.stringify({w: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, \"\n                      \"h: document.documentElement.scrollHeight})\")\n        return json.loads(self.call(\"Runtime.evaluate\", expression=expression,\n                                    returnByValue=True)[\"result\"][\"value\"])\n\n    def screenshot(self, size: dict, width: int, target: Path) -> None:\n        # Never narrower than the page: an overflowing page makes a wider image.\n        data = self.call(\"Page.captureScreenshot\", format=\"png\", captureBeyondViewport=True,\n                         clip={\"x\": 0, \"y\": 0, \"width\": max(size[\"w\"], width),\n                               \"height\": size[\"h\"], \"scale\": 1})[\"data\"]\n        target.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data))\n\n    def close(self) -> None:\n        self.process.terminate()\n        shutil.rmtree(self.profile, ignore_errors=True)\n\n\ndef screens(console: Console) -> list[tuple[str, str, str | None, bool]]:\n    \"\"\"(name, path, who, required) for every admin screen worth measuring.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        (\"login\", \"/login\", None, True),\n        (\"dashboard\", \"/admin\", \"admin\", True),\n        (\"content-list\", \"/admin/content\", \"admin\", True),\n        (\"editor\", \"/admin/posts/1/edit\", \"editor\", True),\n        (\"users\", \"/admin/users\", \"admin\", True),\n        (\"editor-denied\", \"/admin/users\", \"editor\", True),\n        (\"new-post\", \"/admin/posts/new\", \"editor\", False),\n        (\"posts-list\", \"/admin/posts\", \"editor\", False),\n        (\"page-editor\", \"/admin/pages/1/edit\", \"editor\", False),\n        (\"page-editor-admin\", \"/admin/pages/1/edit\", \"admin\", False),\n        (\"pages-list\", \"/admin/pages\", \"admin\", False),\n        (\"new-account\", \"/admin/users/new\", \"admin\", False),\n        (\"account\", \"/admin/users/1\", \"admin\", False),\n    ]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-only\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"measure; write no files\")\n That logic would be better in Python. The inline CSS keeps growing, but it matches the file's existing style.\n- **Weak tests:**\n  - `test_each_required_screenshot_is_a_full_page_at_its_real_width` only checks PNG header dimensions, not content.\n  - `test_t09_mobile` shells out to Chrome, takes a long time, and is skipped without Chrome.\n  - Many feedback tests assert one keyword (`\"saved\" in ...`) rather than the behaviour. The show-once and missing-token tests are meaningful.\n- **Risk for the real `.env` in tests and `scripts/admin_screenshots.py`:**\n  - Importing `app.settings` now loads the developer's real `.env` into `os.environ` during pytest.\n  - `admin_screenshots.py` runs the server and seed with `cwd=ROOT`, so the child process also reads the real `.env`. It is protected only because `CMS_DATABASE`, `CMS_SECRET_KEY` and the passwords are set explicitly and `override=False` lets them win. The real `cms.db` is never touched.\n  - `os.killpg` and `start_new_session` are POSIX-only.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>58496</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>7</tool_uses><duration_ms>31974</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

Two independent reviewers (Standards, Spec).\n\n### Standards\nNo hard violation of CLAUDE.md except one judgement call that needs **your decision**:\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| **`python-dotenv` is used by `app/settings.py` but not declared in `pyproject.toml`.** It is locked (`uv.lock`, via `uvicorn[standard]`, which is declared). \"Ask before adding a dependency\" can be read either way | **Open, your call.** I used the already-locked package as instructed (no new package, no lock change, a test confirms it is locked). If you prefer it declared explicitly, that is a one-line `pyproject.toml` change; I did not make it without asking |\n| Substring match `\"CSRF\" in detail` | **Fixed**: `security.CSRF_FAILURE` constant, compared exactly |\n| Tuple indexed by position in the error page; vague handler name | **Fixed** |\n| Unused `console` parameter in `screens()` | **Fixed** |\n| Nav-stripping regex duplicated across tests | **Fixed**: one `own_content()` helper in `tests/conftest.py` |\n| Importing `app.settings` made pytest read the developer's real `.env` | **Fixed**: `CMS_ENV_FILE` (also a feature) is pointed at nothing in `tests/conftest.py` |\n| `${...}` in a `.env` value would be expanded | **Fixed**: `interpolate=False`; a test fails if it is turned back on (checked by mutation) |\n| ~20 `flash(...)` calls spread across routes; screenshot script's retry loops; macro inside `{% if %}`; `os.killpg` is POSIX-only | Left: judgement calls, small and local |\n\n### Spec (#11 acceptance criteria)\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| No test ran `cms serve` itself; the \"no secret printed\" test ran a dummy command | **Fixed**: a test starts `cms serve` from a clean copy, signs in over HTTP, and checks both its output and the seed's output for the key and both passwords |\n| `/admin/pages/new` and an error page were not measured | **Fixed**: 15 screens measured, including both |\n| The browser check never confirmed the intended screen loaded (a redirect or 404 is also narrow) | **Fixed**: each screen must show its expected path and heading, or the run reports WRONG. Negative control: with the old textarea restored, the editor measured 542 px at a 390 px viewport and the check failed |\n| `--env-file` still working was not tested | The existing `tests/test_t08_release.py` runs the seed through `uv --env-file`; the environment-wins test covers the precedence rule |\n| Report's fresh-context sentence overclaimed | **Fixed**: now says T01 to T07 began after `/clear` or `/implement` (per transcripts), T08 began with `/clear` but has no transcript yet, **and the repair work ran in that same session with no fresh context** |\n| Timestamp in the #10 note | The #10 text says 02:28Z (when I composed it); GitHub's own comment time is 02:29:01Z. Left as is, noted here |\n| Flash text, 4xx handlers, extra CSS | Accepted as needed for the \"clear feedback\" criterion |\n| Acceptance-criteria review had no written artifact | **This comment.** See below |\n\n### Acceptance-criteria coverage review (T04 #5, T06 #7, T08 #9)\nNo test was added only to check documentation wording.\n\n| Ticket | Criterion | Covered by |\n|---|---|---|\n| T04 | create, role, deactivate (session ends), reactivate, password reset not shown, Display name, Author link kept, username never a byline, Editor refused for every action, CSRF on every account form | named tests in `tests/test_t04_users.py` (e.g. `test_deactivation_stops_sign_in_and_ends_an_existing_session`, `test_the_username_is_never_used_as_a_byline`, `test_editor_is_refused_every_account_screen_and_action`); all 19 admin-only routes also probed by hand |\n| T06 | four counts; account counts for Admin only and not reachable by direct request; reminder; type and status filters; row fields; update after changes | `tests/test_t06_dashboard.py` |\n| T06 | \"usable at about 390 px\" | **was a viewport-meta check only; now `tests/test_t09_mobile.py`**, which measures 15 screens in headless Chrome (skipped if Chrome is absent) |\n| T08 | Preview matches the published output, sanitized, image with alt; hint shown, not in the Body, hideable; Editor's Preview reaches no Admin-only action | `tests/test_t08_preview.py` |\n| T08 | seed from `.env.example`, both roles, Published and Draft, one Deactivated; clean-clone sign-in; nothing committed | `tests/test_t08_release.py`; `tests/test_t09_setup.py` now runs the rubric's literal commands in a clean copy, including `cms serve` |\n| T08 | six admin screenshots at 1280 and 390 | `check_submission.py` (names) plus `tests/test_t09_mobile.py` (pixel widths); they were retaken without cropping |\n| T08 | README has Live URL, Run locally, AI Use Statement | `check_submission.py` |\n| T08 | README Backends table; release checklist covering the listed steps and the Editor limit | **Reviewed by reading only.** No existing check covers them, and a wording test would prove nothing, so I did not add one |\n| T08 | Stage 2 checker passes | the checker itself, which also runs the suite |\n\n### Not done here\n- Nothing in this issue moves `mp2-final` or `mp2-mvp`.\n- No usage rows, comments, timestamps or extension were invented.\nEOF\ngh issue comment 11 --body-file The resolved version is unchanged (1.2.3); `uv.lock` changed by two lines (the direct edge and its specifier); `uv lock --check` and `uv sync --locked --dry-run` are clean. A test fails if it stops being declared or locked |\n| **The older tests amended for the shared navigation might only be accepting it** | **Checked by mutation.** The amendments only set the navigation aside (`own_content()`), leaving every original assertion on a screen's own content. Files were restored from git after each run |\n| **Setting the navigation aside could hide a permission leak in it** | **Closed.** A new test holds the navigation to an exact list per role on every admin screen, including the refusal page and the Preview: Editor `[/admin, /admin/content, /admin/posts, /admin/pages]`, Admin plus `/admin/users`; the only form is `/logout` with a CSRF token. Two more mutations (Accounts shown to an Editor; an extra form in the navigation) go red |\n| The Spec review's remaining items | Already resolved in the first comment (cms-serve test, 15 measured screens with a heading check, `CMS_ENV_FILE`, `interpolate=False`, the fresh-context sentence, the coverage review) |\n\n### Re-run after the changes\n- Full suite: **409 passed** (includes the Chrome-based mobile test).\n- `check_submission.py --stage 2`: 22/22. `--stage 1`: 12/12.\n- Neither tag was touched: `mp2-final` is still `e3b0788`, `mp2-mvp` still `06a3070`.\nEOF\ngh issue comment The Pages list had separate Published and Draft filters, so I could see the status of content without opening each page.\n\nI created an Editor account but lost its generated password before logging in, so I did not test editor permissions.\n\n=== client brief\nASA is a Kenyon student group primarily for African students and students with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African cultures and community. The website should make it easy for students to find upcoming events, including an Afrobeat event, learn about the association, explore cultural resources, and see photos from past activities. Event announcements should be quick to publish, while information about ASA and its resources should remain easy to find in the navigation. An ASA leader would manage accounts and permanent pages; another member could write and update event posts. The site should feel welcoming to someone discovering ASA for the first time. Photos should only be published when ASA has permission to use them.\n=== field notes / brief first commit\n49e1c16 2026-09-28T22:26:59-04:00 planning: context glossary, client brief, field notes, token budget plan\nd627c09 2026-09-28T19:08:02-04:00 Initial commit\n=== default template brief in manual/template?\n273:> **Knox County Historical Society.** Three volunteers run the site. Karen, the secretary, posts meeting announcements and event notices weekly; she is comfortable with email and nothing more. Tom, the president, writes longer research pieces every month or two and wants them to look permanent. Nobody should be able to edit the membership page except Tom. {"parentUuid":"3019c788-1211-45dc-83ba-14d5d7fe7891","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyVznMDPEAPU72kZcd8d","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018qjQfUNwAGpZmD4UkgPztu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t10_deploy.py","content":"\"\"\"T10: `cms deploy` pushes the export to the Pages branch, tested without GitHub.\n\nSeam 3 (the `cms` command). The \"remote\" is a bare Git repository in a temporary\nfolder, and Git is limited to the `file` protocol, so nothing here can reach the\nnetwork. This exercises the same `ghp_import` call the real deploy makes.\n\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport subprocess\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import posts, settings\nfrom app.cli import main\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.test_t03_publish import add_post\n\n\ndef git(*args, cwd=None, git_dir=None, binary=False):\n    command = [\"git\"] + ([\"--git-dir\", str(git_dir)] if git_dir else []) + list(args)\n    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, check=True, text=not binary)\n    return result.stdout\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef pages_remote(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A working repository whose `origin` is a local bare repository. Returns that bare repo.\"\"\"\n    for name, value in {\"GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL\": \"file\", \"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL\": os.devnull,\n                        \"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM\": os.devnull, \"GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT\": \"0\",\n                        \"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME\": \"Test\", \"GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL\": \"test@example.com\",\n                        \"GIT_COMMITTER_NAME\": \"Test\", \"GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL\": \"test@example.com\"}.items():\n        monkeypatch.setenv(name, value)\n    bare = tmp_path / \"pages-remote.git\"\n    git(\"init\", \"--bare\", \"-q\", str(bare))\n    work = tmp_path / \"work\"\n    work.mkdir()\n    git(\"init\", \"-q\", cwd=work)\n    git(\"remote\", \"add\", \"origin\", str(bare), cwd=work)\n    (work / \"README\").write_text(\"the project, not the site\")\n    git(\"add\", \".\", cwd=work)\n    git(\"commit\", \"-qm\", \"initial\", cwd=work)\n    monkeypatch.chdir(work)\n    # Nothing can be pushed anywhere except a folder on this machine.\n    assert git(\"remote\", \"get-url\", \"origin\", cwd=work).strip() == str(bare)\n    return bare\n\n\ndef pages_files(bare):\n    return set(git(\"ls-tree\", \"-r\", \"--name-only\", \"gh-pages\", git_dir=bare).split())\n\n\ndef deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):\n    site = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", database=db_path)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    code = main([\"deploy\", \"--message\", \"Publish test\"])\n    return site, code, capsys.readouterr().out\n\n\ndef test_deploy_pushes_every_exported_file_to_gh_pages_and_nothing_else(\n        db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"What: music\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Quiet Draft\", \"not for the public\", published=False)\n\n    site, code, out = deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n\n    assert code == 0 and \"Pushed to gh-pages\" in out\n    exported = {str(p.relative_to(site)) for p in site.rglob(\"*\") if p.is_file()}\n    assert exported <= pages_files(pages_remote)              # .nojekyll is the only extra\n    assert pages_files(pages_remote) - exported == {\".nojekyll\"}\n    for name in exported:                                      # byte for byte\n        assert git(\"show\", f\"gh-pages:{name}\", git_dir=pages_remote, binary=True) == \\\n            (site / name).read_bytes(), name\n    assert \"posts/afrobeat-night.html\" in pages_files(pages_remote)\n    assert git(\"branch\", \"--list\", git_dir=pages_remote).split() == [\"gh-pages\"]   # no main pushed\n\n\ndef test_no_draft_reaches_the_pages_branch(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"What: music\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Quiet Draft\", \"not for the public\", published=False)\n    deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n    everything = \"\".join(\n        git(\"show\", f\"gh-pages:{name}\", git_dir=pages_remote)\n        for name in pages_files(pages_remote) if name.endswith((\".html\", \".css\")))\n    assert \"Quiet Draft\" not in everything and \"quiet-draft\" not in pages_files(pages_remote)\n\n\ndef test_a_second_deploy_replaces_the_branch_so_an_unpublished_post_is_gone(\n        db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"What: music\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Movie Evening\", \"What: film\")\n    deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n    assert {\"posts/afrobeat-night.html\", \"posts/movie-evening.html\"} <= pages_files(pages_remote)\n\n    posts.unpublish(db_path, post_id)\n    _, code, _ = deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n\n    assert code == 0\n    files = pages_files(pages_remote)\n    assert \"posts/afrobeat-night.html\" not in files and \"posts/movie-evening.html\" in files\n    announcements = git(\"show\", \"gh-pages:announcements.html\", git_dir=pages_remote)\n    assert \"Afrobeat Night\" not in announcements and \"Movie Evening\" in announcements\n    assert len(git(\"rev-list\", \"gh-pages\", git_dir=pages_remote).split()) == 2    # a new commit\n\n\ndef test_deploy_refuses_when_there_is_no_site_and_pushes_nothing(\n        tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"no-such-site\")\n    assert main([\"deploy\"]) == 1\n    assert \"cms publish\" in capsys.readouterr().out\n    assert git(\"branch\", \"--list\", git_dir=pages_remote).strip() == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_deploy_cannot_reach_a_network_remote_in_this_test(\n        db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    \"\"\"The safety net the other tests rely on: with only `file` allowed, an https remote fails.\"\"\"\n    work = tmp_path / \"work\"\n    git(\"remote\", \"set-url\", \"origin\", \"https://github.com/example/never-contacted.git\", cwd=work)\n    site = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", database=db_path)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    assert main([\"deploy\"]) != 0\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4668,"cache_read_input_tokens":490367,"output_tokens":4579,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":2035},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4668,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":4579,"cache_read_input_tokens":490367,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4668,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4668},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_018qjQfUNwAGpZmD4UkgPztu":{"file_path":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t10_deploy.py","content":"\"\"\"T10: `cms deploy` pushes the export to the Pages branch, tested without GitHub.\n\nSeam 3 (the `cms` command). Nothing can be pushed anywhere except a folder on this machine.\n    assert git(\"remote\", \"get-url\", \"origin\", cwd=work).strip() == str(bare)\n    return bare\n\n\ndef pages_files(bare):\n    return set(git(\"ls-tree\", \"-r\", \"--name-only\", \"gh-pages\", git_dir=bare).split())\n\n\ndef deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):\n    site = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", database=db_path)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    code = main([\"deploy\", \"--message\", \"Publish test\"])\n    return site, code, capsys.readouterr().out\n\n\ndef test_deploy_pushes_every_exported_file_to_gh_pages_and_nothing_else(\n        db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"What: music\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Quiet Draft\", \"not for the public\", published=False)\n\n    site, code, out = deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n\n    assert code == 0 and \"Pushed to gh-pages\" in out\n    exported = {str(p.relative_to(site)) for p in site.rglob(\"*\") if p.is_file()}\n    assert exported <= pages_files(pages_remote)              # .nojekyll is the only extra\n    assert pages_files(pages_remote) - exported == {\".nojekyll\"}\n    for name in exported:                                      # byte for byte\n        assert git(\"show\", f\"gh-pages:{name}\", git_dir=pages_remote, binary=True) == \\\n            (site / name).read_bytes(), name\n    assert \"posts/afrobeat-night.html\" in pages_files(pages_remote)\n    assert git(\"branch\", \"--list\", git_dir=pages_remote).split() == [\"gh-pages\"]   # no main pushed\n\n\ndef test_no_draft_reaches_the_pages_branch(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"What: music\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Quiet Draft\", \"not for the public\", published=False)\n    deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n    everything = \"\".join(\n        git(\"show\", f\"gh-pages:{name}\", git_dir=pages_remote)\n        for name in pages_files(pages_remote) if name.endswith((\".html\", \".css\")))\n    assert \"Quiet Draft\" not in everything and \"quiet-draft\" not in pages_files(pages_remote)\n\n\ndef test_a_second_deploy_replaces_the_branch_so_an_unpublished_post_is_gone(\n        db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"What: music\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Movie Evening\", \"What: film\")\n    deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n    assert {\"posts/afrobeat-night.html\", \"posts/movie-evening.html\"} <= pages_files(pages_remote)\n\n    posts.unpublish(db_path, post_id)\n    _, code, _ = deploy(db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys)\n\n    assert code == 0\n    files = pages_files(pages_remote)\n    assert \"posts/afrobeat-night.html\" not in files and \"posts/movie-evening.html\" in files\n    announcements = git(\"show\", \"gh-pages:announcements.html\", git_dir=pages_remote)\n    assert \"Afrobeat Night\" not in announcements and \"Movie Evening\" in announcements\n    assert len(git(\"rev-list\", \"gh-pages\", git_dir=pages_remote).split()) == 2    # a new commit\n\n\ndef test_deploy_refuses_when_there_is_no_site_and_pushes_nothing(\n        tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"no-such-site\")\n    assert main([\"deploy\"]) == 1\n    assert \"cms publish\" in capsys.readouterr().out\n    assert git(\"branch\", \"--list\", git_dir=pages_remote).strip() == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_deploy_cannot_reach_a_network_remote_in_this_test(\n        db_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, pages_remote):\n    \"\"\"The safety net the other tests rely on: with only `file` allowed, an https remote fails.\"\"\"\n    work = tmp_path / \"work\"\n    git(\"remote\", \"set-url\", \"origin\", \"https://github.com/example/never-contacted.git\", cwd=work)\n    site = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", database=db_path)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    assert main([\"deploy\"]) != 0\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d86e42fa-297a-4b24-9410-df67458da87a","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"b68357c6-d59e-4995-a597-7ee18ee605d2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"a77ef331-d963-4153-904a-5fde226c3f3f","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

`Backend: <provider> <model>` commit trailers.\nChatGPT is separate planning assistance outside Claude Code, so it is disclosed in\nthe README but is never a table row, a ledger provider or a trailer.\n`scripts/check_backends.py` does the checking; these tests run it on the real\nrepository and on deliberately broken copies, so the check cannot pass by accident.\n\"\"\"\nimport csv\nimport importlib.util\nimport io\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nspec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"check_backends\", ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"check_backends.py\")\ncheck_backends = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\nspec.loader.exec_module(check_backends)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef readme():\n    return (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text()\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef ledger():\n    with (ROOT / \"notes\" / \"usage-ledger.csv\").open() as handle:\n        return list(csv.DictReader(handle))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef history():\n    return subprocess.run([\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"--format=%B\"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n                          text=True, check=True).stdout\n\n\ndef problems(readme, ledger, history):\n    return check_backends.check(readme, ledger, history)\n\n\ndef with_extra_table_row(readme, row):\n    marker = \"| Anthropic | Sonnet 5 / Sonnet 5.5 |\"\n    start = readme.index(marker)\n    end = readme.index(\"\\n\", start)\n    return readme[:end + 1] + row + \"\\n\" + readme[end + 1:]\n\n\n# -- the real repository -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_the_real_readme_ledger_and_history_agree(readme, ledger, history):\n    assert problems(readme, ledger, history) == []\n\n\ndef test_the_real_check_reads_what_it_should(readme, ledger, history):\n    table = check_backends.parse_table(readme)\n    assert [row[\"provider\"].lower() for row in table] == [\"anthropic\"]\n    assert {r[\"provider\"].lower() for r in ledger} == {\"anthropic\"}\n    assert check_backends.trailers(history) == set()\n\n\ndef test_the_command_passes_on_this_repository():\n    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"check_backends.py\")],\n                            cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)\n    assert result.returncode == 0 and \"agree\" in result.stdout\n\n\n# -- every kind of disagreement is caught ----------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_a_ledger_provider_missing_from_the_table_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    ledger = ledger + [{\"provider\": \"openrouter\", \"model\": \"some-model\"}]\n    found = problems(readme, ledger, history)\n    assert any(\"openrouter\" in p and \"table\" in p for p in found)\n\n\ndef test_a_ledger_backup_with_no_commit_trailer_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    readme = with_extra_table_row(\n        readme, \"| OpenRouter | some-model | the backup | `Backend: openrouter some-model` |\")\n    ledger = ledger + [{\"provider\": \"openrouter\", \"model\": \"some-model\"}]\n    found = problems(readme, ledger, history)\n    assert any(\"trailer\" in p and \"openrouter\" in p for p in found)\n\n\ndef test_a_commit_trailer_for_a_provider_not_in_the_table_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    found = problems(readme, ledger, history + \"\\nBackend: openrouter some-model\\n\")\n    assert any(\"trailer\" in p and \"openrouter\" in p for p in found)\n\n\ndef test_a_table_row_nobody_used_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    readme = with_extra_table_row(\n        readme, \"| OpenRouter | some-model | the backup | `Backend: openrouter some-model` |\")\n    found = problems(readme, ledger, history)\n    assert any(\"openrouter\" in p and (\"ledger\" in p or \"used\" in p) for p in found)\n\n\ndef test_a_ledger_model_missing_from_the_table_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    ledger = ledger + [{\"provider\": \"anthropic\", \"model\": \"Haiku 5.5\"}]\n    found = problems(readme, ledger, history)\n    assert any(\"Haiku 5.5\" in p for p in found)\n\n\ndef test_a_backup_row_whose_trailer_column_says_none_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    readme = with_extra_table_row(readme, \"| OpenRouter | some-model | the backup | none needed |\")\n    ledger = ledger + [{\"provider\": \"openrouter\", \"model\": \"some-model\"}]\n    history = history + \"\\nBackend: openrouter some-model\\n\"\n    assert any(\"none\" in p for p in problems(readme, ledger, history))\n\n\n# -- ChatGPT is separate planning assistance ---------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_chatgpt_as_a_backends_row_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    readme = with_extra_table_row(readme, \"| OpenAI | ChatGPT | planning | none needed |\")\n    assert any(\"ChatGPT\" in p and \"table\" in p for p in problems(readme, ledger, history))\n\n\ndef test_chatgpt_as_a_ledger_provider_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    ledger = ledger + [{\"provider\": \"chatgpt\", \"model\": \"ChatGPT\"}]\n    assert any(\"ChatGPT\" in p and \"ledger\" in p for p in problems(readme, ledger, history))\n\n\ndef test_chatgpt_as_a_commit_trailer_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    history = history + \"\\nBackend: openai ChatGPT\\n\"\n    assert any(\"ChatGPT\" in p or \"openai\" in p for p in problems(readme, ledger, history))\n\n\ndef test_chatgpt_help_that_is_not_disclosed_is_caught(readme, ledger, history):\n    undisclosed = readme.replace(\"ChatGPT\", \"an assistant\")\n    assert any(\"not disclosed\" in p for p in problems(undisclosed, ledger, history))\n\n\ndef test_chatgpt_disclosure_sits_outside_the_table(readme):\n    table_text = readme[readme.index(\"### Backends used\"):]\n    first_blank = table_text.index(\"\\n\\n\", table_text.index(\"|---\"))\n    assert \"ChatGPT\" not in table_text[:first_blank]          # the rows themselves\n    assert \"ChatGPT\" in readme[:readme.index(\"### Backends used\")]\n\n\n# -- the table must be readable at all ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_a_readme_with_no_backends_table_is_caught(ledger, history):\n    assert any(\"table\" in p for p in problems(\"# Project\\n\\nNothing here.\\n\", ledger, Reads files and `git log` only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nDEFAULT_PROVIDER = \"anthropic\"          # needs no commit trailer\nSEPARATE_ASSISTANT = \"chatgpt\"\nTRAILER = re.compile(r\"(?m)^Backend:[ \\t]*(\\S+)[ \\t]+(.+?)[ \\t]*$\")\n\n\ndef parse_table(readme: str) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"The rows of the table under '### Backends used', keyed by lower-case header. [] if none.\"\"\"\n    heading = re.search(r\"(?m)^#{2,4}\\s+Backends used\\s*$\", readme)\n    if not heading:\n        return []\n    lines = []\n    for line in readme[heading.end():].splitlines():\n        if line.strip().startswith(\"|\"):\n            lines.append(line)\n        elif lines:\n            break\n    cells = [[c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip(\"|\").split(\"|\")] for line in lines]\n    if len(cells) < 3 or not set(\"\".join(cells[1])) <= set(\"-: \"):      # header, separator, a row\n        return []\n    header = [h.lower() for h in cells[0]]\n    return [dict(zip(header, row)) for row in cells[2:] if any(row)]\n\n\ndef trailer_pairs(history: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return [(provider.lower(), model) for provider, model in TRAILER.findall(history)]\n\n\ndef trailers(history: str) -> set[str]:\n    \"\"\"The providers named by `Backend: <provider> <model>` trailers in a `git log` body dump.\"\"\"\n    return {provider for provider, _ in trailer_pairs(history)}\n\n\ndef check(readme: str, ledger: list[dict], history: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every disagreement between the table, the ledger and the trailers, as sentences.\"\"\"\n    table = parse_table(readme)\n    if not table:\n        return [\"The README has no readable 'Backends used' table \"\n                \"(a Markdown table under a 'Backends used' heading).\"]\n    found: list[str] = []\n    table_providers = {row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower() for row in table}\n    ledger_providers = {r.get(\"provider\", \"\").strip().lower() for r in ledger} - {\"\"}\n    pairs = trailer_pairs(history)\n    trailer_providers = {provider for provider, _ in pairs}\n\n    # ChatGPT: disclosed, but never a backend.\n    if SEPARATE_ASSISTANT not in readme.lower():\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT assistance is not disclosed in the README.\")\n    if any(SEPARATE_ASSISTANT in \" \".join(row.values()).lower() for row in table):\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT is listed in the Backends table; it is separate assistance, not a backend.\")\n    if any(SEPARATE_ASSISTANT in f\"{r.get('provider', '')} {r.get('model', '')}\".lower() for r in ledger):\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT appears in the ledger's provider or model column; it is not a backend.\")\n    if any(SEPARATE_ASSISTANT in f\"{provider} {model}\".lower() for provider, model in pairs):\n        found.append(\"A 'Backend:' commit trailer names ChatGPT; it is not a backend.\")\n\n    # Providers: table, ledger and trailers.\n    for provider in sorted(ledger_providers - table_providers):\n        found.append(f\"Ledger provider '{provider}' has no row in the Backends table.\")\n    for provider in sorted(table_providers - ledger_providers - trailer_providers):\n        found.append(f\"The table lists '{provider}', but neither the ledger nor any commit trailer shows it used.\")\n    for provider in sorted((ledger_providers - {DEFAULT_PROVIDER}) - trailer_providers):\n        found.append(f\"Provider '{provider}' is in the ledger but no commit has a 'Backend: {provider} ...' trailer.\")\n    for provider in sorted(trailer_providers - table_providers):\n        found.append(f\"A commit trailer names '{provider}', which has no row in the Backends table.\")\n    for provider in sorted((trailer_providers - {DEFAULT_PROVIDER}) - ledger_providers):\n        found.append(f\"A commit trailer names '{provider}', which the ledger's provider column never records.\")\n\n    # Models: every model the ledger records for a provider is in that provider's table rows.\n    for provider in sorted(ledger_providers & table_providers):\n        listed = {token.strip().lower() for row in table if row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower() == provider\n                  for token in row.get(\"model\", \"\").split(\"/\")}\n        recorded = {r.get(\"model\", \"\").strip() for r in ledger\n                    if r.get(\"provider\", \"\").strip().lower() == provider} - {\"\"}\n        for model in sorted(recorded):\n            if model.lower() not in listed:\n                found.append(f\"Ledger model '{model}' ({provider}) is not in the table's Model column.\")\n\n    # A backup row must point at its trailers.\n    for row in table:\n        provider = row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower()\n        if provider != DEFAULT_PROVIDER and \"none\" in row.get(\"commit trailer\", \"\").lower():\n            found.append(f\"The table's trailer column for '{provider}' says none, but a non-Anthropic \"\n                         \"backend needs 'Backend:' trailers.\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    readme = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text()\n    with (ROOT / \"notes\" / \"usage-ledger.csv\").open() as handle:\n        ledger = list(csv.DictReader(handle))\n    history = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"--format=%B\"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n                             text=True, check=True).stdout\n    found = check(readme, ledger, history)\n    if found:\n        print(\"The Backends table, the ledger and the commit trailers disagree:\")\n        for line in found:\n            print(f\"  - {"parentUuid":"098e6e12-7574-4c31-837b-e9dc886882da","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyW97KhWY8afMjusvC84","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017WJ2ZRSHCJpvdFQreCm8Kx","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/check_backends.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Check that the README's \"Backends used\" table, the usage ledger and the commit trailers agree.\n\n    uv run python scripts/check_backends.py\n\nThe rubric's H6 asks for three records of which model backend did the work, and that they agree:\n  1. the README's *Backends used* table (provider, model, used for, commit trailer),\n  2. the `provider` and `model` columns of notes/usage-ledger.csv,\n  3. a `Backend: <provider> <model>` trailer on commits made while a non-Anthropic backend was in use.\n\nChatGPT was planning and review assistance outside Claude Code, so it is a separate thing: it must be\ndisclosed in the README, and must not be a table row, a ledger provider or a commit trailer.\n\nExit code 0 when everything agrees, 1 with a list of disagreements. Reads files and `git log` only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nDEFAULT_PROVIDER = \"anthropic\"          # needs no commit trailer\nSEPARATE_ASSISTANT = \"chatgpt\"\nTRAILER = re.compile(r\"(?m)^Backend:[ \\t]*(\\S+)[ \\t]+(.+?)[ \\t]*$\")\n\n\ndef parse_table(readme: str) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"The rows of the table under '### Backends used', keyed by lower-case header. [] if none.\"\"\"\n    heading = re.search(r\"(?m)^#{2,4}\\s+Backends used\\s*$\", readme)\n    if not heading:\n        return []\n    lines = []\n    for line in readme[heading.end():].splitlines():\n        if line.strip().startswith(\"|\"):\n            lines.append(line)\n        elif lines:\n            break\n    cells = [[c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip(\"|\").split(\"|\")] for line in lines]\n    if len(cells) < 3 or not set(\"\".join(cells[1])) <= set(\"-: \"):      # header, separator, a row\n        return []\n    header = [h.lower() for h in cells[0]]\n    return [dict(zip(header, row)) for row in cells[2:] if any(row)]\n\n\ndef trailer_pairs(history: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return [(provider.lower(), model) for provider, model in TRAILER.findall(history)]\n\n\ndef trailers(history: str) -> set[str]:\n    \"\"\"The providers named by `Backend: <provider> <model>` trailers in a `git log` body dump.\"\"\"\n    return {provider for provider, _ in trailer_pairs(history)}\n\n\ndef check(readme: str, ledger: list[dict], history: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every disagreement between the table, the ledger and the trailers, as sentences.\"\"\"\n    table = parse_table(readme)\n    if not table:\n        return [\"The README has no readable 'Backends used' table \"\n                \"(a Markdown table under a 'Backends used' heading).\"]\n    found: list[str] = []\n    table_providers = {row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower() for row in table}\n    ledger_providers = {r.get(\"provider\", \"\").strip().lower() for r in ledger} - {\"\"}\n    pairs = trailer_pairs(history)\n    trailer_providers = {provider for provider, _ in pairs}\n\n    # ChatGPT: disclosed, but never a backend.\n    if SEPARATE_ASSISTANT not in readme.lower():\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT assistance is not disclosed in the README.\")\n    if any(SEPARATE_ASSISTANT in \" \".join(row.values()).lower() for row in table):\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT is listed in the Backends table; it is separate assistance, not a backend.\")\n    if any(SEPARATE_ASSISTANT in f\"{r.get('provider', '')} {r.get('model', '')}\".lower() for r in ledger):\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT appears in the ledger's provider or model column; it is not a backend.\")\n    if any(SEPARATE_ASSISTANT in f\"{provider} {model}\".lower() for provider, model in pairs):\n        found.append(\"A 'Backend:' commit trailer names ChatGPT; it is not a backend.\")\n\n    # Providers: table, ledger and trailers.\n    for provider in sorted(ledger_providers - table_providers):\n        found.append(f\"Ledger provider '{provider}' has no row in the Backends table.\")\n    for provider in sorted(table_providers - ledger_providers - trailer_providers):\n        found.append(f\"The table lists '{provider}', but neither the ledger nor any commit trailer shows it used.\")\n    for provider in sorted((ledger_providers - {DEFAULT_PROVIDER}) - trailer_providers):\n        found.append(f\"Provider '{provider}' is in the ledger but no commit has a 'Backend: {provider} ...' trailer.\")\n    for provider in sorted(trailer_providers - table_providers):\n        found.append(f\"A commit trailer names '{provider}', which has no row in the Backends table.\")\n    for provider in sorted((trailer_providers - {DEFAULT_PROVIDER}) - ledger_providers):\n        found.append(f\"A commit trailer names '{provider}', which the ledger's provider column never records.\")\n\n    # Models: every model the ledger records for a provider is in that provider's table rows.\n    for provider in sorted(ledger_providers & table_providers):\n        listed = {token.strip().lower() for row in table if row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower() == provider\n                  for token in row.get(\"model\", \"\").split(\"/\")}\n        recorded = {r.get(\"model\", \"\").strip() for r in ledger\n                    if r.get(\"provider\", \"\").strip().lower() == provider} - {\"\"}\n        for model in sorted(recorded):\n            if model.lower() not in listed:\n                found.append(f\"Ledger model '{model}' ({provider}) is not in the table's Model column.\")\n\n    # A backup row must point at its trailers.\n    for row in table:\n        provider = row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower()\n        if provider != DEFAULT_PROVIDER and \"none\" in row.get(\"commit trailer\", \"\").lower():\n            found.append(f\"The table's trailer column for '{provider}' says none, but a non-Anthropic \"\n                         \"backend needs 'Backend:' trailers.\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    readme = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text()\n    with (ROOT / \"notes\" / \"usage-ledger.csv\").open() as handle:\n        ledger = list(csv.DictReader(handle))\n    history = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"--format=%B\"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n                             text=True, check=True).stdout\n    found = check(readme, ledger, history)\n    if found:\n        print(\"The Backends table, the ledger and the commit trailers disagree:\")\n        for line in found:\n            print(f\"  - {\"\"}\n        for model in sorted(recorded):\n            if model.lower() not in listed:\n                found.append(f\"Ledger model '{model}' ({provider}) is not in the table's Model column.\")\n\n    # A backup row must point at its trailers.\n    for row in table:\n        provider = row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower()\n        if provider != DEFAULT_PROVIDER and \"none\" in row.get(\"commit trailer\", \"\").lower():\n            found.append(f\"The table's trailer column for '{provider}' says none, but a non-Anthropic \"\n                         \"backend needs 'Backend:' trailers.\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    readme = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text()\n    with (ROOT / \"notes\" / \"usage-ledger.csv\").open() as handle:\n        ledger = list(csv.DictReader(handle))\n    history = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"--format=%B\"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n                             text=True, check=True).stdout\n    found = check(readme, ledger, history)\n    if found:\n        print(\"The Backends table, the ledger and the commit trailers disagree:\")\n        for line in found:\n            print(f\"  - {\"\"}\n    pairs = trailer_pairs(history)\n    trailer_providers = {provider for provider, _ in pairs}\n\n    # ChatGPT: disclosed, but never a backend.\n    if False:\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT assistance is not disclosed in the README.\")\n    if False:\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT is listed in the Backends table; it is separate assistance, not a backend.\")\n    if False:\n        found.append(\"ChatGPT appears in the ledger's provider or model column; it is not a backend.\")\n    if False:\n        found.append(\"A 'Backend:' commit trailer names ChatGPT; it is not a backend.\")\n\n    # Providers: table, ledger and trailers.\n    for provider in []:\n        found.append(f\"Ledger provider '{provider}' has no row in the Backends table.\")\n    for provider in []:\n        found.append(f\"The table lists '{provider}', but neither the ledger nor any commit trailer shows it used.\")\n    for provider in []:\n        found.append(f\"Provider '{provider}' is in the ledger but no commit has a 'Backend: {provider} ...' trailer.\")\n    for provider in []:\n        found.append(f\"A commit trailer names '{provider}', which has no row in the Backends table.\")\n    for provider in []:\n        found.append(f\"A commit trailer names '{provider}', which the ledger's provider column never records.\")\n\n    # Models: every model the ledger records for a provider is in that provider's table rows.\n    for provider in sorted(ledger_providers & table_providers):\n        listed = {token.strip().lower() for row in table if row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower() == provider\n                  for token in row.get(\"model\", \"\").split(\"/\")}\n        recorded = {r.get(\"model\", \"\").strip() for r in ledger\n                    if r.get(\"provider\", \"\").strip().lower() == provider} - {\"\"}\n        for model in sorted(recorded):\n            if False:\n                found.append(f\"Ledger model '{model}' ({provider}) is not in the table's Model column.\")\n\n    # A backup row must point at its trailers.\n    for row in table:\n        provider = row.get(\"provider\", \"\").lower()\n        if False and \"none\" in row.get(\"commit trailer\", \"\").lower():\n            found.append(f\"The table's trailer column for '{provider}' says none, but a non-Anthropic \"\n                         \"backend needs 'Backend:' trailers.\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    readme = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text()\n    with (ROOT / \"notes\" / \"usage-ledger.csv\").open() as handle:\n        ledger = list(csv.DictReader(handle))\n    history = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"--format=%B\"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n                             text=True, check=True).stdout\n    found = check(readme, ledger, history)\n    if found:\n        print(\"The Backends table, the ledger and the commit trailers disagree:\")\n        for line in found:\n            print(f\"  -
